Identify and secure eligible leads as quickly as possible.

description:
Hi there!



We're looking for an experienced, detail-obsessed Photo Editor to join our growing creative team. You'll be working with two Australian businesses:



Loved Up Creatives is a wedding photography and videography business. We capture real, emotional wedding days, and our edits need to feel timeless, natural and true to colour.



OP Digital Solutions is a digital marketing and website agency. We shoot for clients across many industries, including restaurants and cafés, corporate, sport, hospitality, retail, products and more. These images end up on websites, social media and ads, so they need to look polished, on-brand and ready to sell.



Your time will be split roughly 50/50 between the two businesses, so we need someone who can handle both. You might deliver a soft, romantic 800-image wedding gallery one day and sharp, scroll-stopping food and headshot images the next.



You'll join our existing team of Philippines-based editors and work directly with our Australian team.





About the Role



Wedding editing (Loved Up Creatives):



- Edit full wedding galleries (500–1,000+ images) in Adobe Lightroom

- Keep colour, exposure and skin tones consistent across a whole gallery, even when light changes all day

- Cull efficiently, picking the best moments and removing duplicates, blinks and misses

 - Match our style closely using our presets and reference galleries

- Light retouching on hero images (blemishes, distractions, stray hairs)



Commercial editing (OP Digital Solutions):



- Edit for different industries: food and beverage, venues and interiors, corporate headshots and team photos, sport, events, products and lifestyle

- Retouch in Adobe Photoshop, including skin retouching, object and background removal, cleanup, straightening and perspective correction

- Adapt your editing style to each client's brand rather than applying one look to everything

- Export correctly for web, social and print (sizing, crops and formats)

- Handle quick-turnaround social content alongside larger shoots



Across both:



- Meet agreed turnaround times

- Take feedback well and apply it consistently

- Communicate clearly about briefs, questions, revisions and deadlines

- Keep files organised and follow our naming and delivery processes



Ideal Requirements



- 2+ years of professional photo editing experience

- Portfolio required, ideally with wedding work AND commercial work (food, corporate, product, real estate, sport or similar)

- Advanced Adobe Lightroom and strong Adobe Photoshop skills

- Proven experience editing high-volume wedding galleries

- A strong eye for natural colour and accurate skin tones

- Excellent written English communication

- Highly organised, reliable and deadline-driven

- Reliable high-speed internet, a capable computer, and a colour-calibrated monitor



Nice to have (not required)



- Experience editing for Australian or international photographers or agencies

- Familiarity with light, airy, true-to-colour wedding styles

- Experience with food, hospitality or product retouching

- Familiarity with tools like Aftershoot, Imagen or Photo Mechanic for culling

- Basic video editing skills (a bonus, not a must)



What We Offer



- Full-time, long-term role with a stable, growing team

- Varied, interesting work. No two weeks look the same

- Work alongside a supportive team of fellow editors

- Paid time off, annual & sick leave



How to Apply



Please include:



- A short introduction about yourself

- Your portfolio link, with wedding AND commercial examples (required)

- Years of experience in each: weddings, and commercial or other industries

- The software you use and your skill level in each





Shortlisted applicants will be asked to complete a test edit covering a wedding set and a commercial set.



To show us you've read this ad, please let us know your favourite song.

title: Education Program Manager (Online Property Education)
description:
Role at a Glance



- Position title: Education Program Manager

- Team: Online education course (property renovation and investment)

- Reports to: Chief Operations Officer, with a direct line to the Director on strategy

- Location: Remote, Philippines

- Engagement: Independent contractor, full-time (40 hours per week). Starts part-time (20 hours per week) during training and probation, then moves to full-time.

- Working hours: Monday to Friday, within Melbourne business hours (8am - 5pm AEST/AEDT / 5am - 2pm PHT), plus one weekly evening group call (Wednesday, 7:00 PM Melbourne, which is 4:00 PM in the Philippines)

- Start date: As soon as possible

- Pay: USD $8–10 per hour, depending on experience





About Us

We are an Australian property investment business. We renovate and invest in residential property with our money partners, and we help clients buy the right property. Our online education course teaches everyday investors how to invest in property and add value through renovation. Our team works remotely across Australia, the Philippines, Vietnam and Indonesia.

We celebrate differences. We value different points of view, open communication and respectful debate, because better ideas come from people who think differently. We use AI tools and clear systems every day so the whole team can work smarter.







About the Role

This is a management role. You will lead the team that runs our online property education course and make sure the work gets done: on time, to a high standard and without anything falling through the cracks. You will set priorities, keep people accountable, solve problems as they come up, and keep the Director clearly informed every week.

The two things that matter most in this role are communication and execution. We are looking for someone who is clear and direct with people, follows through on every commitment, and gets things done.







Key Responsibilities

- Team leadership: Lead and manage the program team, including operations, student support and coaching support. Set clear weekly priorities, hold regular one-on-ones, and give feedback early and kindly.

- Execution: Turn plans into action. Break work into tasks with one owner and a due date in ClickUp, follow up until each one is done, and remove blockers so the team can keep moving.

- Weekly team meeting: Run the weekly team meeting, keep it short and focused, and make sure every decision and action is written down and followed up.

- Communication: Be the single point of contact between the program team and Marketing, the website team, Finance and Admin, and the Director. Keep everyone working to the same plan and dates.

- Program delivery: Make sure the online course runs smoothly every week: student onboarding, the weekly group call, student support and the online community.

- Problem solving: Spot issues early, d
 what to do, and fix them, whether that is a delayed task, a student complaint, a payment problem or a website issue.

- Weekly update: Send the Director a short update every Friday: what got done, what is behind, the key numbers, and decisions needed.

- SOPs and systems: Write and keep current the SOPs the team needs, so work is done the same way every time and new team members can get up to speed quickly.

- Hiring and onboarding: Help hire, onboard and train new team members as the program grows.

- Compliance: Make sure the team stays on the general education side: no personal financial or credit advice, no income promises, and policies applied as written.







What Success Looks Like

- Clear ownership: Every part of the program has an owner, and core SOPs are written, by day 30

- Execution: Agreed weekly priorities delivered on time, and overdue tasks followed up within 2 business days

- Communication: Friday update sent to the Director every week; no surprises on delays or problems

- Team: Regular one-on-ones held, and every team member knows their priorities each week

- Program delivery: Weekly group calls, onboarding and student support run on schedule







Skills and Experience

Must have

- Based in the Philippines

- 3 or more years managing or leading a team, ideally remote

- At least 1 year of experience in an education, coaching or online course program

- Strong experience in a similar or relevant industry, such as property, real estate, online business or customer operations

- Strong execution skills: a track record of getting things done, on time, with little supervision

title: Work From Home Merchandise Allocator (Fashion Retail) | 6am to 2pm PHT, Mon to Fri
description:
SALARY

US$270 per week.



HOURS

9:00am to 5:00pm Sydney time (Australian Eastern Time), Monday to Friday.

That is 6:00am to 2:00pm Philippine time now (Australian daylight saving), and 7:00am to 3:00pm PHT from April when daylight saving ends. No night shift.



ABOUT THE ROLE



An established Australian women's fashion brand, selling through its own retail stores and online, is hiring a Merchandise Allocator who owns allocation and replenishment day to day.



This is not an "upload and execute" role. You must understand and explain the drivers behind every allocation: how you seed a new collection, when consolidations make sense, and how you manage priorities with your Planning Manager. If you cannot walk through those fundamentals clearly, this role is not a fit.



You will report to the Planning Manager and work from home on Sydney hours.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Own model stock and replenishment across retail stores and ecommerce in the brand's retail ERP / merchandise system (training is available if you have used a similar system)

- Allocate new seasonal collections from first drop through early replenishment, using store tiering, capacity, size profiles, last-season performance and planned intake, not gut feel alone

- Run ongoing allocations, store transfers and consolidations using rate of sale, sell-through, weeks cover, stock on hand, inventory age and broken size runs

- Spot and act on consolidation triggers early (trading data and seasonal / calendar events), and bring a clear recommendation to the Planning Manager rather than waiting to be told

- Turn weekly trade into actions: what to move, replenish, consolidate or mark down, and why

- Prepare weekly and monthly sales, stock and allocation reports that lead with insights and recommendations

- Balance warehouse deadlines, store replenishment pressure and manager requests without dropping the ball, and communicate trade-offs upwards

- Improve and automate manual reports and models where you can



MUST-HAVES



- Fluent spoken and written English (non-negotiable)

- Hands-on experience with a retail ERP or merchandise planning / allocation system (for example AP21 / Apparel21, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, Cin7, Retail Pro, JDA / Oracle, or similar)

- Proven stock allocation experience with a fashion retailer, apparel brand or department store

- At least 1 year as an Allocator, Merchandise Assistant or similar inventory / allocation role in fashion, apparel or retail, with exposure beyond pure execution (trade analysis, recommendations, consolidations or markdowns)

- Can clearly explain how you approach allocating a new collection (inputs, sequence, hold-back for replenishment, hero vs slow styles)

- Can name the data points and seasonal events that trigger consolidations, with a real example

- Can manage upwards: prioritise under pressure and give the Planning Manager a decision-ready view

- Strong grasp of retail metrics: sell-through, weeks cover, stock turn, rate of sale, inventory age

- Advanced Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, XLOOKUP / VLOOKUP, formulas, reporting). Shortlisted candidates complete a short Excel analysis task

- Able to work independently, own outcomes end to end, and work Mon to Fri, 9:00am to 5:00pm Sydney time



HIGHLY REGARDED



- Building or refining store tiering, capacity or size-profile frameworks

- Allocating across both retail and ecommerce

- Automation skills (VBA, Google Apps Script or similar)

- Junior Planner or merchandise planning experience

- A passion for fashion and retail



THE RIGHT PERSON



You do not just push stock. You can explain the commercial logic: how a new collection gets seeded, what forces a consolidation, and how you protect bestsellers while clearing aged inventory. You read the numbers, recommend the next move, and keep your manager informed when priorities collide. You look for ways to improve the process rather than wait to be told.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application subject line with ALLOCATOR-27 so we know you read the ad. Applications without it, or that skip the questions, will not be reviewed.



1. Attach your updated CV.

2. Answer all three questions below in your application.

3. Confirm your earliest start date and that you can work Mon to Fri, 9:00am to 5:00pm Sydney time (6:00am to 2:00pm PHT now, 7:00am to 3:00pm PHT from April), at US$270 per week.



REQUIRED QUESTIONS



1. A new seasonal collection has just landed in the warehouse and needs first allocation across retail stores and ecommerce before it goes live. Walk us through how you would approach that allocation from scratch. Cover at least: which data and inputs you would pull before you allocate a single unit (for example last season sell-through by store/style/size, store tiering or capacity, size curves, planned intake, ecommerce demand); how you would d
 depth by store vs holding back for replenishment; how you would treat hero styles vs slow movers; and what you would check in week one after the drop. Do not give a generic "I would look at sales and send stock" answer. Name the metrics and the sequence.



2. What events or data points would make you recommend consolidating stock (pulling from some stores / channels into others, or back to DC)? Give specific examples across both trading data (for example weeks cover, rate of sale, sell-through, inventory age, broken size runs, stockouts elsewhere) and calendar / seasonal events (for example end of season, promo window, new collection intake, store refit or closure). For one real example from your past role, say what you saw, what you recommended, who you took it to, and what happened.



3. It is Monday morning Sydney time. You have: (a) a new collection allocation that must leave the warehouse today, (b) three stores chasing urgent replenishment on bestsellers that are stocked out, and (c) your Planning Manager has asked for a clear recommendation on consolidating aged winter stock before a promotion next week, for a catch-up in two hours. How do you prioritise, what do you do first, what do you defer, and exactly how do you communicate upwards so the manager has a decision-ready view without you dropping the urgent store or warehouse work?



Fluent English is required.

title: Executive Assistant to Project Manager – Australian Energy Company
description:
About Stratton Global

Stratton Global is an Australian commercial and industrial (C&I) energy management and asset upgrade company, with offices in Wodonga and Melbourne, Victoria. We upgrade refrigeration, air conditioning, solar and battery systems for supermarkets, cold storage facilities and other large industrial sites, and we monitor them remotely with our own IoT platform.

We're a small, fast-moving team. Each person here has real ownership of their work, and you'll work directly with our Project Manager, not through layers of management.



About the role

We're looking for an organised, proactive Executive Assistant to support Asher White, our Project Manager. Asher runs installation projects across multiple sites at once. Your job is to keep his inbox, his task list and his follow-ups under control so nothing slips through the cracks.

You'll be the first point of contact for many of the Australian businesses we work with: suppliers, customers, electricians and other trades. You'll chase deliveries, manage warranty claims and complaints, and make sure every job has its paperwork completed.

This is a full-time role (40 hours per week, Monday to Friday).



Key responsibilities

Inbox and task management

• Manage Asher's inbox daily: sort, prioritise, reply to routine
s, and flag what needs his attention

• Keep his task list up to date and remind him of due and overdue tasks

• Manage his calendar, book meetings and site visits, and prepare short daily or weekly summaries

• Follow up on actions after meetings and calls so nothing is left hanging

Supplier and delivery coordination

• Communicate with Australian suppliers and freight companies about orders and delivery times

• Track deliveries to job sites and let Asher and the site know of any delays early

• Liaise with overseas suppliers by
 and WeChat when needed

Warranty, complaints and customer service

• Receive and log warranty claims and customer complaints

• Maintain the warranty and complaints register, keeping every case up to date until it is closed

• Coordinate between customers, suppliers and technicians to get issues resolved

• Respond to customers professionally and calmly, and escalate urgent or sensitive issues to Asher

Trades and compliance paperwork

• Follow up electricians and other trades for electrical certificates (e.g. Certificates of Electrical Safety) and other compliance documents after each job

• Track which jobs are still missing paperwork and chase until everything is received and filed

• Keep project files organised in Google Drive

General admin

• Update customer and job records in Pipedrive (CRM)

• Look up supplier bills and job details in Xero when needed

• Use AI tools (Claude) to draft
s, summarise threads and work faster

• Other admin tasks to support Asher and the projects team



What we're looking for

Must have

• At least 2 years' experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant or Admin/Customer Service Coordinator

• Excellent written and spoken English, confident dealing with Australian business owners, suppliers and tradespeople

• Very organised, with a strong habit of following up until a task is done

• Calm and professional when handling complaints and difficult conversations

• Able to work on your own, prioritise, and know when to escalate

• Reliable internet connection, backup power or internet, and a quiet workspace with a headset

• Available during Australian business hours (Melbourne time)

Nice to have

• Experience supporting Australian clients

• Experience with warranty claims, complaints registers or customer service ticketing

• Experience with a CRM (e.g. Pipedrive) or project management tools

You don't need prior experience with our specific tools. We'll train you.

Tools you'll use

Experience with these is not required. Full training is provided.

• Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Sheets)

• Pipedrive (CRM)

• Xero (accounting, view and look-up only)

• Claude (AI assistant)

• WhatsApp and WeChat (messaging with trades and suppliers)

title: Linkedin Outbound Setter
description:
💰 $500 Signing Bonus | Hourly Pay + Uncapped Performance Incentives



Turn Conversations Into Business Opportunities



Are you a strong communicator who enjoys connecting with people, building relationships, and creating opportunities?



Demand Acquisition is expanding its business development team and looking for driven individuals to help us connect with business owners who want to grow their companies.



We specialize in helping businesses acquire more customers through marketing strategies, lead generation systems, sales processes, and customer acquisition solutions.



We're looking for someone who can take initiative, communicate professionally, and consistently turn prospect conversations into qualified sales opportunities.



This position is ideal for someone who wants to develop valuable skills in B2B sales, marketing, lead generation, and business development while earning based on performance.



No advanced experience is required. We provide the training, systems, resources, and support needed to succeed.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



Your responsibility is to generate interest, educate potential customers, nurture relationships, and schedule qualified appointments for our sales team.



Find & Connect With Business Owners



- Research and identify potential business clients.

- Prospect through LinkedIn, Instagram,
, and other approved platforms.

- Send personalized outreach messages and initiate professional conversations.

- Generate interest in Demand Acquisition's services.



Manage Conversations & Follow-Ups



- Respond to incoming messages and inquiries.

- Follow up with prospects who haven't responded.

- Maintain consistent communication with interested business owners.

- Re-engage prospects who may need additional information before making a decision.



Educate & Nurture Potential Clients



- Share educational YouTube videos, case studies, and business resources.

- Explain our services and how our customer acquisition systems work.

- Invite interested prospects into our free SKOOL community.

- Help prospects understand the problems we solve before speaking with our sales team.



Qualify Leads & Schedule Appointments



- Ask questions to understand each prospect's business and objectives.

- Identify serious business owners who may benefit from our services.

- Make follow-up calls to interested prospects when appropriate.

- Schedule qualified Zoom appointments with our sales representatives.

- Confirm appointments and help maximize attendance.



Track Your Performance



- Update prospect information and conversations in our CRM.

- Organize follow-up tasks and lead statuses.

- Maintain accurate records of daily outreach and appointments.

- Submit daily activity and performance reports.



Important: This is an appointment-setting and business development position, not a closing role. You will focus on generating, educating, nurturing, and qualifying opportunities. Our sales team is responsible for conducting sales calls and closing clients.



WHAT MAKES SOMEONE SUCCESSFUL IN THIS ROLE?



We're looking for individuals who take pride in their work and understand that consistent execution produces results.



The ideal candidate:



- Speaks and writes English fluently.

- Has excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

- Is persistent and doesn't give up after one unanswered message.

- Has strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Is comfortable initiating conversations with business owners.

- Can follow established processes and execute instructions.

- Is coachable and actively looks for ways to improve.

- Can work independently and manage daily responsibilities.

- Is comfortable using LinkedIn and other social media platforms.



Previous experience in appointment setting, sales, telemarketing, customer service, or lead generation is helpful but not mandatory.



We value work ethic, consistency, communication, and the willingness to learn.



 REQUIRED EQUIPMENT & AVAILABILITY



- Personal computer or laptop.

- Reliable high-speed internet connection.

- Webcam and microphone.

- Quiet and professional working environment.

- Availability for a full-time, 40-hour workweek.

- Basic computer skills and familiarity with Google Sheets.



Experience with GoHighLevel or other CRM platforms is an advantage.



 ⭐️LINKEDIN IS A CORE PART OF THIS POSITION



Our business development team uses LinkedIn daily to identify and connect with business owners.



For this reason, applicants must:



- ⭐️Have an active LinkedIn account under their real identity or be willing to create and verify one before beginning training.

- Have access to their own personal LinkedIn profile.

- Be comfortable with daily professional networking and outbound messaging.

- Provide their LinkedIn profile URL when applying.



Purchased, borrowed, fake, or shared accounts are not permitted.



If you're unwilling or unable to meet these requirements, this position will not be a good fit.



WHAT WE PROVIDE



We want our team members to develop professionally while producing meaningful results.



You'll receive:



- Direct training and mentorship from company leadership.

- Established outreach scripts and prospecting strategies.

- Educational materials and training resources.

- Guidance on B2B sales, communication, and lead qualification.

- CRM systems and structured workflows.

- Ongoing feedback and performance coaching.

- Opportunities to earn additional compensation through performance.

- Opportunities for advancement as the company grows.



We're interested in building long-term working relationships with people who demonstrate commitment and strong performance.



COMPENSATION & INCENTIVES

We believe compensation should reward both consistency and measurable results.



Starting Compensation: $3 USD per hour + performance-based incentives.



Initial Training Period



During the initial training and ramp-up period, compensation includes:



- Performance-based appointment commissions.

- Additional daily, weekly, and monthly bonuses.

- Eligibility for the $500 signing bonus.

- Additional rewards for appointments that turn into paying clients.



Full-Time Position



After successfully completing training and demonstrating that you're a good fit, you'll transition into the full-time compensation structure.



This includes:



- Guaranteed hourly pay.

- Appointment commissions.

- Performance bonuses.

- Additional incentives tied to business results.



Appointment Incentives



- $15–$25+ for every qualified appointment that attends its scheduled Zoom meeting.

- $150+ additional commission when an appointment you generated converts into a closed client.



We have a good offer. Our sales team has historically converted approximately 40%+ of qualified appointments.



Experienced appointment setters have averaged approximately $1600–$2,133 USD per month.



There is additional earning potential for individuals who consistently perform at a high level.



Your results matter. The more qualified opportunities you generate and the more consistently you execute, the greater your earning potential.



OUR CULTURE & EXPECTATIONS

At Demand Acquisition, we believe in building a team around a few important principles:



- Take action quickly.

- Follow up consistently.

- Educate prospects and build trust.

- Pay attention to the details.

- Communicate openly.

- Take responsibility for your results.

- Improve your skills every day.

- Prioritize quality over unnecessary activity.



We want people who are serious about improving, developing their abilities, and contributing to a growing company.



APPLICATION PROCESS

We want to learn more about you before scheduling an interview.



Please submit the following:

1. Resume: Include a link to your resume with your employment history and relevant experience.



2. Introduction Video or Voice Recording: Introduce yourself, explain your background, and tell us why you're interested in joining Demand Acquisition.



3. Communication Skills: Briefly describe your experience communicating with customers, business owners, or potential clients.



4. Persistence: Explain how you would handle a prospect who doesn't respond to your first or second outreach message.



5. LinkedIn Profile: Provide the URL to your personal LinkedIn account.



6. Attention to Detail: Include the phrase "EDUCATE WITH VIDEO" somewhere in your application.



Please follow all application instructions. Incomplete applications may not be considered.



We are actively reviewing candidates and looking to bring new team members on board as soon as possible.



 🎉 YOUR $500 SIGNING BONUS

We offer a $500 signing bonus to reward individuals who commit to completing our initial training program.



Here's how it works:



- Earn $20 per week during the first eight weeks of initial training, in addition to performance compensation.

- Complete the full eight-week training period successfully.

- Receive the remaining $340 after successfully completing training.



The full $500 bonus is contingent upon successful completion of the eight-week training program.



We're looking for people who want more than just another job. We want individuals who are motivated to develop professionally, build valuable business skills, and grow alongside our company.



If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.



Demand Acquisition is an equal opportunity employer committed to hiring a diverse and talented workforce.

title: Operations Manager
description:
Operations Manager



Wambold Properties | Remote | Full-Time Preferred



About Us



Wambold Properties is a growing boutique interior design and short-term rental management company serving clients across the United States.



We are seeking an experienced, highly organized, and entrepreneurial Operations Manager to work directly with our founder, oversee our growing team, streamline business operations, and support continued company growth.



This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who enjoys developing people, building systems, solving problems, and contributing across multiple areas of a growing business.



Key Responsibilities



Team Management & Leadership



* Oversee daily operations across interior design, procurement, installations, property management, sales, and social media.

* Manage team workloads, schedules, priorities, performance, and accountability.

* Ensure team members meet deadlines, communicate proactively, and fulfill their responsibilities.

* Lead team meetings and individual check-ins.

* Identify staffing needs, workload imbalances, and opportunities to improve productivity.

* Provide hands-on support across departments when additional assistance is needed.

* Independently resolve routine operational challenges and escalate significant concerns with recommended solutions.

* Support the development of employee performance standards and management processes.



Recruitment, Onboarding & Training



* Assist with recruiting, interviewing, and evaluating candidates across all departments.

* Take ownership of new hire onboarding and training.

* Develop structured training programs, resources, and performance expectations.

* Coordinate department-specific training with existing team members.

* Monitor new hire progress and ensure employees are equipped to perform their responsibilities independently.

* Provide ongoing coaching, feedback, and professional development.

* Identify future hiring needs based on business growth and team capacity.



Project & Client Oversight



* Maintain visibility into all active projects, client commitments, deadlines, and deliverables.

* Ensure projects remain on schedule and departments communicate effectively.

* Monitor client communication, outstanding approvals, contracts, payments, and follow-ups.

* Identify potential delays, resource limitations, and operational challenges before they escalate.

* Assist with client communication and issue resolution when needed.

* Ensure a consistently high standard of service across all departments.



Installation & Vendor Management



* Oversee U.S.-based installation teams, project-based contractors, and external vendors.

* Manage installation staffing, schedules, resource allocation, and project coverage.

* Coordinate with design and procurement teams to ensure installations are properly planned and executed.

* Identify, recruit, and evaluate qualified local installation professionals, contractors, and vendors across various U.S. markets.

* Develop and maintain a reliable network of installation partners.

* Establish alternative staffing plans when internal installation team members are unavailable.

* Oversee installation budgets, timelines, vendor performance, and quality standards.

* Monitor installation readiness and ensure outstanding issues are resolved.

* Develop standardized installation processes, expectations, and training resources.



Sales & Business Development



* Support the founder throughout the sales process, from initial inquiry through client onboarding.

* Assist with lead generation, prospect outreach, appointment setting, and client follow-ups.

* Maintain visibility into the sales pipeline and ensure opportunities are consistently followed up on.

* Assist with proposals, contracts, and sales presentations.

* Participate in prospective client meetings and develop the ability to independently conduct sales consultations and close new business.

* Identify opportunities to improve lead conversion, client retention, and revenue growth.

* Support referral partnerships and strategic business relationships.

* Research new business opportunities and recommend growth initiatives.

* Develop and improve sales processes, scripts, and training resources.



Systems & Process Improvement



* Develop, implement, and maintain company-wide SOPs.

* Evaluate existing workflows and identify opportunities to improve efficiency.

* Establish effective systems for tracking projects, leads, client communication, and team performance.

* Ensure processes are consistently followed and updated as the business evolves.

* Research and implement relevant technology, AI tools, and automation.

* Develop scalable operational systems that reduce reliance on the founder for daily operations.



Founder Support & Business Performance



* Work directly with the founder to establish business priorities and execute strategic initiatives.

* Assist with calendar management, business commitments, and outstanding action items.

* Establish and monitor departmental KPIs and performance metrics.

* Provide consolidated updates on team performance, project progress, sales activity, and operational priorities.

* Monitor operational expenses and identify opportunities to improve profitability.

* Prepare meeting agendas, document decisions, and ensure action items are completed.

* Anticipate business needs and proactively recommend solutions.



Qualifications



* Previous experience in operations management, business management, or team leadership.

* Demonstrated experience managing and developing remote or distributed teams.

* Experience recruiting, onboarding, training, and managing employee performance.

* Strong leadership, delegation, and decision-making skills.

* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

* Strong client-facing communication and presentation abilities.

* Experience developing SOPs, training programs, and operational workflows.

* Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.

* Ability to manage multiple departments, projects, and competing priorities.

* Experience coordinating vendors, contractors, or project-based teams.

* Proficiency in Google Workspace, spreadsheets, project management tools, and communication platforms.

* Comfortable learning and implementing AI tools and automation.

* Experience in sales, business development, or client relationship management is strongly preferred.

* Experience in hospitality, real estate, interior design, property management, or a growing small business is a plus.



Schedule & Availability



* Full-time availability preferred.

* Meaningful overlap with U.S. Eastern business hours.

* Flexibility to collaborate with international team members working across different schedules.

* Occasional flexibility outside standard working hours when business needs arise.



Who We’re Looking For



We are looking for someone who:



* Thinks like a business owner rather than simply completing assigned tasks.

* Takes initiative without waiting for direction.

* Is comfortable holding others accountable while providing meaningful support.

* Is willing to roll up their sleeves and assist wherever needed.

* Can balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution.

* Anticipates challenges and brings solutions to leadership.

* Is commercially minded and interested in contributing to business growth.

* Is excited about growing alongside an entrepreneurial company.



This is an opportunity to work directly with the founder, take meaningful ownership of business operations, and grow into a senior leadership position as Wambold Properties continues to expand.



How to Apply



Interested candidates should send a direct message with their résumé and a brief introduction outlining their relevant experience.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
Location: Work-from-home (Independent Contractor)

Contract Type: Contractor, Full-Time

Schedule: Monday to Friday, ideally 8:30 AM–4:30 PM UK time. A 7:00 AM–3:00 PM UK schedule may also be considered.



We are looking for an experienced Marketing Manager to join an established UK-based business.



As the business continues to grow, it is looking to bring its marketing activity in-house and appoint an experienced Marketing Manager who can take ownership of its marketing across website management, digital advertising, SEO,
 campaigns, social media, customer data and marketing collateral.



About the Role



We are seeking an experienced and commercially focused Marketing Manager to take ownership of the business’s day-to-day marketing activities and help drive measurable business growth.



This is a hands-on, varied role suited to an experienced marketing all-rounder who is comfortable managing multiple marketing channels independently with light oversight.



The successful candidate will work closely with the Sales Manager and will be responsible for planning, delivering and reporting on marketing initiatives designed to increase customer retention, grow existing customer spend, generate new leads, build brand awareness in new areas and support the sales team.



A significant part of the role will also involve bringing website, design and digital marketing work currently handled externally into the internal team.



Main Priorities



The main priorities for this role are:



Lead Generation



Finding and attracting new prospective customers.



Creating marketing activities that generate measurable leads and enquiries.



Promoting the Brand



Increasing awareness among prospective and existing customers.



Making sure the brand is visible and consistently represented across marketing channels.



Website Improvement

title: Social Media Sales & Engagement Specialist
description:
# Social Media Sales & Engagement Specialist



**Part-time | 20 hours/week | $600 USD/month, with the opportunity to earn additional performance-based bonuses.**



## About the role



Somia is an international health and wellness education company looking for an experienced, empathetic and sales-minded individual to take primary ownership of direct messages and comments across our three Instagram accounts.



You'll be an integral member of our international team, building relationships with our audience, helping prospective customers understand our programs and converting genuine interest into sales through thoughtful, personalized conversations.



## Key responsibilities



- Respond to DMs and comments across all three Instagram accounts with warmth, accuracy and attention to detail.

- Identify sales opportunities, understand prospective customers' needs, address objections and guide them toward appropriate programs and offers.

- Recognize opportunities to move conversations from public comments into DMs.

- Redirect Somia Customer Questions to our Support Team.

- Proactively follow up with interested prospects and ensure potential sales opportunities are not overlooked.

- Oversee DM and comment coverage, coordinating with other team members who provide additional support.

- Track and report weekly on DM sales performance, common objections, successful sales approaches and opportunities for improvement.

- Develop and improve sales approaches, response guidelines, SOPs and FAQs.

- Help other team members improve their customer support and conversational sales skills.

- Stay informed about our programs, offers and ongoing marketing campaigns.

- Share valuable customer insights, testimonials, personal stories and recurring questions with the wider team.

- Assist with developing responses for Instagram Stories Q&As over time.



## Qualifications



- Demonstrated experience in customer support and conversational sales.

- Experience converting customer conversations into purchases through DMs or live chat.

- Experience managing a high volume of customer conversations across social media accounts.

- Exceptional written English and interpersonal communication skills.

- Strong emotional intelligence and the ability to handle sensitive conversations with empathy, confidence and appropriate boundaries.

- Ability to analyze sales conversations, identify patterns and improve sales and customer support processes.

- Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail and sound judgment.

- Ability to take initiative, work independently and collaborate effectively within a team.



A background in psychology, counselling, health and wellness, or experience working with coaching businesses, online education programs or memberships is highly desirable.



## Working hours



20 hours per week, spread across 5 days, with a split-shift schedule:



- Evening shift: 9–11 p.m. Philippine time.

- Midday shift: Approximately one hour around noon Philippine time.

- Flexible hours: Two additional hours per week.

- Every weekday + 1 weekend per month.



Reporting, analysis, team communication and process improvements are included within the 20 weekly hours.



Flexibility to adjust working hours and provide weekend coverage, particularly during marketing campaigns, is essential.



Attendance at weekly team meetings.



## What we're looking for



We want someone who genuinely enjoys connecting with people, understands the psychology of sales and takes pride in providing exceptional customer service.



You should be comfortable taking ownership of our DM and comment operations, identifying opportunities for improvement and helping the entire team become more effective at supporting customers and generating sales.



## How to apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. Briefly describe your most relevant customer support experience, particularly in environments where customers' needs were personal, sensitive or emotionally complex.

2. What experience do you have generating sales through DMs or live chat? Please be specific about what you were selling and your responsibilities.

3. Confirm that you are comfortable with the compensation and working hours outlined in this posting, and let us know when you would be available to start.



### Video introduction



Please share a short unscripted video of yourself (up to 3 minutes) answering the following questions:



1. What are you looking for in your next role? If this position turned out to be a great fit for you, what would that look like six months from now?



2. Many of the people who reach out to us are dealing with chronic illness or other difficult personal circumstances and want to learn more about our programs. How would you approach these conversations, and what do you think makes someone particularly effective at turning genuine interest into sales?

title: B2B LinkedIn Outreach
description:
B2B LinkedIn Outbound Appointment Setter – Cold Outreach, Lead Nurturing & Booking Calls

💰 $500 SIGN-ON BONUS



Build Your Career With Purpose

We are Demand Acquisition, a fast-growing B2B company helping business owners acquire more clients through marketing, sales systems, lead nurturing, and business growth solutions.

We are looking for reliable, persistent, and growth-minded appointment setters to connect with business owners, educate prospects, build relationships, and book qualified sales calls.

You'll work with prospects through cold outreach, direct messages, follow-ups, educational videos, and our free SKOOL community.



HOW YOU'LL MAKE AN IMPACT (RESPONSIBILITIES)

Your primary responsibility is to turn cold prospects into educated, qualified leads who are ready to speak with our sales team.

Cold Outreach: Contact business owners through LinkedIn, Instagram, Cold
 and other approved platforms.

Follow-Up: Consistently follow up with prospects to generate responses and build relationships.

Educate Prospects: Send relevant YouTube videos, case studies, trainings, and educational resources.

Build Relationships: Start conversations, understand business owners' challenges, and create interest in our solutions.

Community Building: Invite interested prospects into our free SKOOL community to learn more about our business and services.

Lead Nurturing: Stay in contact with prospects as they consume content and become more interested in solving their business problems.

Book Qualified Calls: Schedule qualified Zoom appointments with interested business owners.

Warm Calling: Call interested prospects to follow up, qualify them, and help move them toward booking a sales call.

CRM Management: Track conversations, update lead statuses, and schedule follow-ups.

Daily Reporting: Track outreach, responses, conversations, community members added, appointments booked, and appointments that show up.



IMPORTANT: Your primary responsibilities are cold outreach, educating prospects through video, following up, calling leads, and booking qualified appointments.

You are NOT responsible for closing sales. Your job is to get the right prospects educated, interested, qualified, and booked onto sales calls.



WHAT IT TAKES TO SUCCEED

The ideal candidate must have:

Fluent English (written and spoken).

Excellent communication skills.

Reliable internet, computer, webcam, and quiet workspace.

Availability to work full-time (40 hours per week).

Persistence and comfort with consistent follow-up.

Excellent attention to detail.

Experience using LinkedIn and other social media platforms.

Experience with CRM software (GoHighLevel preferred) and Google Sheets.

Ability to follow scripts, implement feedback, and execute instructions consistently.

Previous experience in appointment setting, sales, or lead generation is a plus, but not required. We provide training.



⭐️Mandatory LinkedIn Requirement⭐️

This position requires daily prospecting, cold messaging, follow-ups, and appointment setting through LinkedIn.

Applicants must already have an active LinkedIn account under their real name OR be willing and able to create and verify an account using their authentic identity before starting training.

You must have access to your own LinkedIn profile.

Purchased, borrowed, shared, or fake LinkedIn accounts are not permitted.

You must be comfortable using LinkedIn daily for professional outreach.

You must be able to provide your LinkedIn profile URL during the application process.

Important: If you do not have access to a legitimate LinkedIn account and are unwilling or unable to create one, please do not apply.



HOW YOU'LL PARTNER WITH OTHERS

Work alongside experienced sales leaders who will coach and support your development.

Participate in weekly team meetings, training, and collaborative learning.

Build your skills in sales, marketing, communication, and business development.

Earn daily, weekly, and monthly performance bonuses.

Opportunity to grow within the company.



WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE

At Demand Acquisition, we invest in your development through training, mentorship, support, and opportunities for career advancement. You have direct access to leadership for ongoing guidance and support.

We believe exceptional people should be exceptionally rewarded. Your earning potential is directly tied to your performance, consistency, and results.



💰 COMPENSATION STRUCTURE

This position offers hourly pay, performance-based commissions, and additional bonuses.

This is a commission-based position during the initial training and ramp-up phase, with a transition to a full-time position that guarantees hourly pay, commissions, and performance bonuses.



Starting compensation: $3/hour plus performance incentives



Phase 1 – Training & Ramp-Up

Performance commissions.

Additional daily, weekly, and monthly performance bonuses on appointments.

Sign-on bonus pay

Opportunity to earn additional bonuses for qualified appointments that convert into deals.



Phase 2 – Full-Time Position

Upon successfully completing training and demonstrating that you're a good fit, you'll transition into a full-time position with:

Guaranteed hourly pay.

Performance-based commissions.

Additional daily, weekly, and monthly performance bonuses on appointments.

Opportunity to earn additional bonuses for qualified appointments that convert into deals.



Appointment Bonuses:

$15-$25+ for each qualified appointment you generate that successfully shows up to its scheduled Zoom call.

$150+ for each qualified appointment you generate that converts into a closed deal by our sales team.



We have an amazing offer. Our sales team has historically converted approximately 40%+ of all qualified appointments.

Your compensation and earning potential will increase as you consistently deliver results. The harder you work and the better you perform, the more you earn.

Average earnings: $796 to $1,933 USD a month for experienced appointment setters. 



OUR CORE VALUES

SPEED IS KING.

PERSISTENCE WINS.

EDUCATE EVERYONE.

IMPROVE EVERY DAY.

OPEN COMMUNICATION.

QUALITY OVER QUANTITY.

EXECUTION IS EVERYTHING.



HOW TO APPLY

If you believe you're a great fit for this position, please include the following in your application:



Resume: Include a link to your resume outlining your experience.

Introduction Video or Voice Recording: Introduce yourself and explain your experience. We want to hear your voice and assess your English fluency and communication skills.

Why are you a great outbound appointment setter? Explain why you believe you'd be successful in this position.

Follow-Up: What makes you good at following up with people consistently?

Attention to Detail: Include the words "EDUCATE WITH VIDEO" somewhere in your application.



APPLICATIONS THAT DO NOT FOLLOW THESE INSTRUCTIONS WILL NOT BE REVIEWED.

We are growing fast, and hiring and training ASAP. Applications are being reviewed IMMEDIATELY.



We look forward to hearing from you and potentially building something great together!



🎉 $500 SIGN-ON BONUS EXPLAINED

Demand Acquisition offers a $500 sign-on bonus, paid weekly in $20 increments during the first eight weeks of initial training on top of your performance pay. The full sign-on bonus is contingent upon successfully completing the eight weeks of initial training. Upon completion, the remaining $340 will be paid.



Demand Acquisition is an equal opportunity employer committed to hiring a diverse and talented workforce.

title: LinkedIn Outreach Appointment Setting SDR
description:
B2B Appointment Setting (SDR) – LinkedIn Prospecting, Lead Nurturing & Appointment Setting



💰 Earn $3/Hour + Commissions + Performance Bonuses | $500 Signing Bonus



Help Business Owners Grow While Building Your Sales Career



Demand Acquisition is looking for motivated, competitive, and coachable individuals to join our business development team.



We help businesses generate more customers and increase revenue by building complete marketing and sales acquisition systems.



We're looking for someone who enjoys communicating with people, starting conversations, following up, and turning potential opportunities into qualified sales appointments.



This isn't a traditional telemarketing position. You'll be responsible for developing relationships with business owners, sharing valuable educational content, nurturing interested prospects, and connecting qualified opportunities with our sales team.



No advanced sales experience is necessary. We provide training, resources, scripts, and ongoing mentorship.



YOUR DAY-TO-DAY RESPONSIBILITIES

Your job is to create opportunities and move prospects through our education and appointment-setting process.



1. Prospecting & Outreach

- Identify business owners and potential prospects through LinkedIn and other social platforms.

- Send personalized connection requests and direct messages.

- Initiate conversations and generate interest in our services.



2. Follow-Up & Relationship Building

- Follow up with prospects who haven't responded.

- Maintain conversations with interested business owners.

- Re-engage prospects who have shown interest but haven't scheduled a call.



3. Prospect Education

- Share relevant YouTube videos, business breakdowns, case studies, and training materials.

- Explain how our systems help businesses acquire more customers.

- Direct interested prospects to our free SKOOL educational community.



4. Lead Qualification & Appointment Setting

- Identify prospects who have a genuine interest in growing their business.

- Ask questions to understand their business challenges and goals.

- Call interested prospects when appropriate.

- Schedule qualified Zoom appointments with our sales representatives.



5. CRM & Performance Tracking

- Keep prospect information organized in our CRM.

- Document conversations and follow-up activities.

- Track outreach volume, responses, appointments, and show-up rates.

- Submit daily performance reports.



Your primary objective: Turn cold prospects into educated, interested, qualified business owners who are ready to have a conversation with our sales team.



You will NOT be responsible for closing deals. Our sales team handles the sales presentations and closing process.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're looking for someone who is:

- Persistent and comfortable following up multiple times.

- Confident communicating with business owners.

- Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

- Organized and detail-oriented.

- Coachable and willing to implement feedback.

- Self-motivated and consistent with daily activity.

- Comfortable using LinkedIn and social media.

- Interested in developing a career in sales and business development.



Technical Requirements:

- Reliable computer and high-speed internet.

- Webcam and quiet working environment.

- Availability for 40 hours per week.

- Familiarity with Google Sheets and CRM platforms.

- GoHighLevel experience is a plus.



Previous appointment-setting, customer service, sales, or lead-generation experience is beneficial but not required.



LINKEDIN ACCOUNT REQUIREMENT

LinkedIn is a major part of our prospecting and appointment-setting process.



Applicants must:

- Have an active LinkedIn account registered under their authentic identity OR be willing to create and verify one before training.

- Have access to their own LinkedIn profile.

- Be comfortable conducting daily professional outreach.

- Include their LinkedIn profile URL in their application.



We do not permit purchased, borrowed, fake, or shared LinkedIn accounts.



Please do not apply if you cannot meet these requirements.



TRAINING, DEVELOPMENT & CAREER OPPORTUNITY



You'll work directly with leadership and receive guidance on:

- B2B prospecting and LinkedIn outreach.

- Effective messaging and conversation strategies.

- Lead nurturing and follow-up systems.

- Sales psychology and prospect qualification.

- Using educational content to build trust.

- CRM management and appointment-setting workflows.



We conduct regular training sessions, performance reviews, and team meetings to help you improve.



High performers will have opportunities for increased compensation, additional responsibilities, and advancement within the company.



COMPENSATION & EARNING POTENTIAL

We believe people who consistently produce results should be rewarded accordingly.



Our compensation structure combines hourly pay, appointment commissions, and performance bonuses.



Initial Starting Compensation: $3 USD/Hour + Performance Incentives



Training & Initial Ramp-Up

- Performance-based appointment commissions.

- Additional daily, weekly, and monthly bonuses.

- Eligibility for the $500 signing bonus.

- Additional incentives when your appointments convert into closed deals.



Full-Time Compensation

After successfully completing initial training and demonstrating consistent performance, you'll transition into our full-time compensation structure, which includes:

- Guaranteed hourly compensation.

- Appointment-setting commissions.

- Additional performance bonuses.

- Increased earning opportunities based on results.



Appointment Commission Structure

- $15–$25+ for each qualified appointment that attends its scheduled Zoom meeting.

- $150+ additional commission when your qualified appointment becomes a closed client.



Our sales team has historically converted approximately 40%+ of qualified appointments.



Average Monthly Earnings: $796–$1,933 USD for experienced appointment setters.



Your earning potential increases as your consistency, performance, and contribution to the company improve.



 OUR COMPANY VALUES

We operate by a few fundamental principles:



- SPEED MATTERS: Take action and move opportunities forward.

- PERSISTENCE WINS: Consistent follow-up creates opportunities.

- EDUCATION BUILDS TRUST: Help prospects understand before asking them to buy.

- ATTENTION TO DETAIL: Execute the process correctly.

- CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT: Get better every day.

- QUALITY OVER QUANTITY: Focus on qualified opportunities.

- ACCOUNTABILITY: Take ownership of your performance.



HOW TO APPLY

To be considered, please include the following:



1. Resume: Provide a link to your current resume.



2. Introduction Video or Voice Recording: Tell us about yourself, your background, and why you're interested in this opportunity. We want to hear your English communication skills.



3. Relevant Experience: Briefly explain any experience you have with sales, appointment setting, customer service, lead generation, or communicating with potential customers.

title: Influencer & Creator Relationship Specialist (Part-Time)
description:
We're looking for an outgoing, friendly, and highly personable individual who genuinely loves connecting with people.



This is not a typical administrative or influencer outreach role. We're looking for someone who naturally builds strong, meaningful relationships with content creators and knows how to make people feel valued, supported, and excited to work with us.



The ideal candidate is someone who can turn professional connections into genuine, lasting relationships. Someone who remembers personal details, checks in naturally, keeps conversations engaging, and makes creators feel like they're talking to a friend rather than a company representative.



You'll be working closely with influencers and content creators through Trybe, helping them get started, building relationships, and keeping them motivated to grow and succeed with our brand.



Key Responsibilities

• Build genuine, long-term relationships with influencers and content creators.

• Develop friendly, personal connections beyond transactional brand communications.

• Make creators feel welcomed, appreciated, and excited to collaborate with us.

• Regularly check in with creators, maintaining natural and engaging conversations.

• Encourage and motivate creators to stay active, create content, and achieve better results.

• Onboard new creators through Trybe and guide them through the process.

• Follow up proactively while keeping interactions warm and personal.

• Remember important details about creators and personalize future conversations.

• Maintain positive relationships that encourage creators to continue working with our brand.



What We're Looking For

• An outgoing, sociable, and naturally friendly personality.

• Someone who genuinely enjoys meeting new people and building connections.

• Excellent interpersonal and conversational skills.

• Previous experience building and maintaining personal relationships with influencers or content creators.

• Ability to make conversations feel authentic, engaging, and comfortable.

• Someone who knows how to motivate, encourage, and inspire others.

• Strong emotional intelligence, empathy, and active listening skills.

• A proactive personality who takes initiative to reach out and maintain relationships.

• Excellent written and spoken English.

• Comfortable communicating through social media, messaging platforms, and video calls.



Important: We're not looking for someone whose experience is limited to sending outreach
s, managing spreadsheets, or coordinating campaigns. We want someone who has personally built strong, ongoing relationships with creators and genuinely enjoys doing so.



Compensation & Growth

• Starting salary is $250/month for 4 hours per day.

• This position starts part-time, with the opportunity to transition to full-time as our creator network grows.



How to Apply

Please submit your resume and a short introduction answering the following:

1. Tell us about your experience building and maintaining genuine relationships with influencers or content creators. How did you keep those relationships strong over time?

2. Share an example of a creator you developed a particularly strong working relationship with. What did you do differently to build that connection?

3. How would you describe your personality and your approach to connecting with new people?

We'd love to hear from people who genuinely enjoy connecting with others and believe great relationships are the foundation of successful creator partnerships!

title: Technical Support Specialist
description:
• Pay: USD 950 a month base, plus performance incentives. Our top performers take home about USD 1,100 to 1,200 a month.

• Shift: Monday to Friday, US Eastern daytime in staggered shifts between 8 AM and 8 PM, with some weekend shifts and on-call turns (a night shift in Manila)

• Benefits: HMO from your third month, flexible paid time off

• Where: fully remote



THE JOB

Our patients are mostly older adults at home in the US with heart failure or COPD. They see their care team by video on a tablet we send them, and their pulse oximeter and blood pressure monitor send readings to us. When something stops working, you are the person who fixes it, often by walking a patient who is not comfortable with technology through it one step at a time.



You take about 50 calls a day from patients and clinicians: a tablet that will not join a visit, a device that stopped sending readings, a clinician who needs help in Athenahealth. You own each problem until it is solved, and you write clear reports for our engineers when something needs a fix on their side.



ABOUT ANSIBLEHEALTH

AnsibleHealth is a US medical group for people living with serious heart and lung disease, such as heart failure and COPD. Health systems and health plans send us their patients, often right after a hospital stay. Our own doctors, nurse practitioners, nurses and respiratory therapists then look after them at home by video and phone: we adjust medicines, treat flare-ups early, teach patients and their families, and are on call day and night. The goal is fewer trips back to the hospital. We were founded in 2021, are backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, First Round Capital and AlleyCorp, and our team works across the United States and the Philippines.



WHAT YOU NEED



• 2 or more years in technical or customer support where you solved technology problems for customers

• Tech savviness: you pick up new devices and tools quickly (Android tablets, Zoom, Google Workspace)

• A friendly, patient way of helping older adults in the US, in clear English

• Reliable high-speed internet and availability for this shift for the long term

Experience with Samsung Knox or another device-management tool, remote monitoring devices, Athenahealth, or an issue tracker such as GitLab is a plus.

description:

title: Interior Designer - Short Term Rental and Hospitality
description:
Interior Designer – Short-Term Rentals & Hospitality



Wambold Properties | Remote



About Us



Wambold Properties is a growing boutique interior design and short-term rental management company specializing in distinctive, experience-driven vacation rentals across the United States.



Our approach combines creative interior design, hospitality, and investment strategy to create memorable spaces that stand out in competitive rental markets.



We are seeking a talented, creative, and detail-oriented Interior Designer to join our growing team. The ideal candidate understands how to balance aesthetics, functionality, guest experience, and investment budgets while developing unique designs tailored to each property.



Key Responsibilities



Design Strategy & Concept Development



* Develop distinctive design concepts tailored to each property’s location, target audience, and investment goals.

* Research local markets, competing properties, design trends, and target guest demographics.

* Create cohesive mood boards, color palettes, and design presentations.

* Identify opportunities to differentiate properties through unique design features, amenities, and memorable guest experiences.

* Develop creative solutions that maximize both functionality and revenue potential.



Space Planning & Interior Design



* Create functional furniture layouts and space plans based on property measurements and floor plans.

* Develop high-quality 2D layouts and 3D renderings.

* Design cohesive interiors, outdoor living spaces, game rooms, entertainment areas, and other guest-focused amenities.

* Select furniture, lighting, décor, wallpaper, paint, finishes, textiles, and accessories.

* Consider durability, maintenance, safety, guest capacity, and functionality when making design decisions.

* Ensure designs are visually compelling, practical, and achievable within established budgets.



Product Sourcing & Budget Management



* Source furniture, décor, and materials from approved retailers and trade vendors.

* Utilize trade programs and purchasing platforms to maximize client budgets.

* Prepare detailed, accurate product selection lists, including specifications, dimensions, quantities, pricing, and product links.

* Ensure selected products are appropriate for the space, budget, and project timeline.

* Recommend suitable alternatives when products become unavailable or exceed budget.

* Collaborate with the Project & Procurement Coordinator to ensure approved designs are accurately translated into purchasing and installation plans.



Design Delivery & Collaboration



* Manage assigned design projects and meet established deadlines.

* Present design concepts and recommendations clearly to internal team members and clients when needed.

* Incorporate approved client feedback in accordance with the project’s scope of work.

* Prepare comprehensive design packages and installation instructions.

* Collaborate with procurement and installation teams to maintain design integrity throughout execution.

* Review completed installations and photography when needed to ensure alignment with the approved design.

* Contribute to the continuous improvement of design standards, templates, SOPs, and workflows.



Qualifications



* Previous professional interior design experience.

* Strong portfolio demonstrating creativity, versatility, and attention to detail.

* Experience with space planning, furniture sourcing, mood boards, and 3D renderings.

* Proficiency in interior design and rendering software.

* Strong understanding of color theory, scale, proportion, materials, and lighting.

* Ability to design within varying budgets and project timelines.

* Familiarity with U.S. furniture retailers, vendors, and design trends.

* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

* Strong organizational and time management skills.

* Ability to independently manage multiple design projects.

* Comfortable utilizing AI and emerging design technologies.

* Experience in short-term rental, hospitality, or commercial interior design is strongly preferred.



Who We’re Looking For



We are looking for someone who is not afraid to think outside the box and can create spaces that go beyond traditional residential interior design.



The ideal candidate is resourceful, proactive, receptive to feedback, and capable of taking ownership of projects from concept through final design delivery.



We value designers who understand that successful short-term rental design is not just about creating beautiful spaces. It is about creating memorable experiences, attracting bookings, and maximizing the potential of each property.



How to Apply



Please submit:



* Your résumé.

* Your interior design portfolio.

* Examples of mood boards, space plans, and 3D renderings you have personally created.

* A brief overview of your experience with hospitality or short-term rental design, if applicable.

* Your preferred design software and tools.

* Your availability and compensation expectations.

title: Remote Operations Assistant: Morning Shift (Part-Time) | Tucson Supreme Clean
description:
Remote Operations Assistant (Part-Time, Morning Shift)



Tucson Supreme Clean is a residential cleaning company in Tucson, Arizona. We do deep cleans, moving cleans and recurring home cleanings across Tucson and the surrounding towns. We're hiring one person to run our morning operations: make sure every cleaner shows up, every client feels taken care of, and problems get solved before they turn into bigger ones.



This job is for people who think, not just follow steps.



We'll give you training, scripts and a dashboard that shows what's happening in real time. But no morning goes exactly to plan. A cleaner gets a flat tire. A client changes the scope at the door. Two jobs run long at the same time. Nobody will hand you a rule for every situation, and that's on purpose. We want someone who understands what we're trying to do, figures out the best move, makes the call, and tells us what they did.



If you'd rather be told exactly what to do at every step, this isn't the right fit. If you like owning the outcome and solving problems, you'll do well here, and the pay reflects that.



Pay



$200 per week, paid weekly

Bonuses for Google reviews and for keeping recurring clients, and they grow the longer you're with us



Schedule



Monday to Friday, 8:00am to 12:30pm Arizona time (22.5 hours a week)

Optional Saturdays for extra pay

You need to be fully available for the whole shift, every shift. If you have another job during these hours, this role isn't for you.



What you'll own



Getting every cleaner to their job on time, and stepping in fast when someone isn't on the way

Covering call-outs: finding a replacement or working out a new time with the client so nobody is left waiting

Answering every client and cleaner text and call quickly during your shift

Keeping clients informed when plans change, before they have to ask

Finding out what each first-time client cares about most and making sure the cleaners know

Joining live video walkthroughs at the end of first-time cleanings, as a second set of eyes

Checking in with clients after their cleanings and catching small problems before they become cancellations

Handling complaints: getting the cleaners' side, working out what happened and getting it fixed

title: Creative Designer
description:
**Creative Designer for E-commerce |
 & Instagram Static Ads | Long-Term**



**About us**



We are a fast-growing online store selling handmade copper jewelry to customers in Poland. Our customers are mainly women aged 50 and over.



We are looking for a Creative Designer who can turn product photos, customer insights, and creative briefs into compelling static ads for
 and Instagram.



This role combines design and advertising. Your work should catch the right person’s attention, communicate one clear idea, and make our products appealing and easy to understand.



**What you will do**



• Create static image ads for
 and Instagram.

• Develop different concepts, headlines, and layouts from our briefs and reference ads.

• Create variations of promising ads to test different hooks, images, and messages.

• Design product collages, carousel ads, promotional graphics, and organic social posts when needed.

• Adapt creatives for feed, Stories, and other requested placements.

• Use our real product photos and brand assets accurately.

• Work with Polish copy using approved translations and tools such as DeepL or ChatGPT.

• Check spelling, readability, spacing, image quality, and consistency before submitting work.

• Organize editable files and exports so the team can quickly find and reuse them.

• Communicate with the owner and video editors through 
.

• Use performance feedback to improve your next round of designs.



**What good work looks like**



• One clear message per ad.

• Strong visual hierarchy and text that is easy to read on a phone, especially for an older audience.

• Accurate product details, including shape, color, and finish.

• Genuinely different creative ideas, rather than small cosmetic changes to the same template.

• Designs that suit our brand and audience.

• Clean, organized source files and reliable delivery.



**What you need**



• A portfolio showing static ads for e-commerce brands.
 or Instagram ad examples are strongly preferred.

• Strong skills in Photoshop, Canva, Figma, or a comparable design tool.

• A good understanding of direct-response advertising: hooks, benefits, offers, visual hierarchy, and calls to action.

• Excellent attention to detail and the ability to follow a brief.

• Good written English and clear communication.

• Confidence working with Polish text using translation tools carefully. You do not need to speak Polish.

• The ability to explain the thinking behind a design and respond constructively to feedback.

• Reliable internet and consistent availability during agreed working hours.



Experience designing for jewelry, accessories, or an audience aged 50 and over is a plus.



**AI tools**



You may use AI tools to support your work, but we expect judgment and careful quality control.



Do not invent reviews, customer numbers, product benefits, or claims. Do not use AI to change the appearance of our jewelry or create misleading product images. Ask when information is missing.



**Schedule and workload**



This is a recurring, long-term role with agreed weekly deadlines.



Please include your available hours per week, your time zone, and the hours during which you can communicate with our team. We will agree on the starting workload and schedule before you begin.



We value thoughtful concepts, reliable delivery, and consistent quality. We do not expect unlimited designs or revisions.



**What we offer**



• A long-term position with room to grow as the store expands.

• Agreed monthly compensation, paid on time.

• Product assets, brand guidance, creative references, and clear feedback.

• Collaboration with the owner and our video editors.

• The opportunity to learn which creative ideas perform and improve your skills through testing.



**How to apply**



Please complete all five steps:



1. Start your application by telling us your favorite food and why you enjoy it.

2. In 3 to 5 sentences, explain why you would be a strong fit for this role.

3. Share 3 to 5 relevant static ad examples. Explain your contribution to each. For one example, describe the audience, the main message, and why you chose that design. If you share performance results, explain how they were measured.

4. Answer this question:  

   **“You receive five product photos of a copper bracelet and a brief targeting Polish women aged 50 and over. How would you turn those assets into three genuinely different static ad concepts?”**  

   A short written answer is enough. You do not need to create designs for your application.

5. Include your preferred tools, available hours per week, earliest start date, and expected monthly compensation in USD for the availability you propose.



Shortlisted candidates may be invited to complete a small paid design task using our assets and a clear brief.



Applications without the requested information will not be considered.
