title: Video Editor & Content Researcher – True Crime / Police Bodycam Documentary YouTube Channel
description:
JOB TITLE: Video Editor & Content Researcher – True Crime / Police Bodycam Documentary YouTube Channel



About the Role

I'm launching a true-crime YouTube channel that turns police bodycam footage into cinematic, Netflix-style documentaries. I need a reliable, self-driven virtual assistant to help build the channel from research through to publishing. This is an ongoing role, with room to grow into a team lead as the channel scales.



Key Responsibilities



Footage Sourcing & Research

Find compelling, high-quality police bodycam and related footage that has not been widely covered on YouTube.

Verify where each clip comes from (public records releases, police department or court channels, public-domain or properly licensed sources).

Keep a tracker (Google Sheet) of sourced cases, links, licensing/usage status, and case details.

Case Research & Scriptwriting

Research each case: timeline, background, outcome, court records, and legal context.

Write binge-worthy narration scripts with strong hooks, pacing, and cliffhangers, plus educational segments (legal rights, police procedure, de-escalation, the justice process).

Video Editing

Edit raw footage into a polished, documentary-style video: voice-over, music, sound design, captions, graphics, maps, timelines, and on-screen explainers.

Use blur and censoring where needed to follow YouTube's guidelines on graphic content.

Deliver consistent, high-quality videos on an agreed schedule.

Channel Management & Growth

Create thumbnails, titles, descriptions, tags, and chapters optimized for search and click-through.

Upload and schedule videos; set up end screens, cards, and playlists.

Track analytics (CTR, retention, watch time) and report what's working.

Competitor & Niche Analysis

Study successful true-crime and bodycam channels, including Dr Insanity, to understand their format, pacing, narrative structure, and posting schedule.

Recommend ways to improve on what they do and to give our channel its own identity, voice, and branding.

Monetization Support

Help the channel meet YouTube Partner Program requirements and keep it compliant with copyright, community guideline, and advertiser-friendly policies.

Help explore additional revenue streams (sponsorships, affiliate links, merchandise, memberships).



Requirements



Proven video editing experience (Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut, or CapCut Pro), with a portfolio or samples

Strong English writing and comprehension; voice-over skills are a plus

Experience with YouTube SEO, thumbnails, and analytics

Understanding of YouTube's copyright, fair use, and monetization policies

Strong research skills and attention to detail

Comfortable with sensitive and sometimes disturbing content

Reliable internet, a capable computer, and the ability to meet deadlines independently

Good communication in English (Slack, Google Meet, or similar)



Nice to Have



Previous true-crime or documentary-style channel experience

Motion graphics skills (After Effects)

Experience managing or growing a YouTube channel



Work Details



Full-time or part-time (state your availability)

Remote, with flexible hours but firm delivery deadlines

Long-term opportunity for the right person



Compensation

Negotiable based on experience, quality of work, and output. Please include your expected rate in your application.



To Apply, Please Send:



Your resume or profile link

2–3 video editing samples (documentary, commentary, or true-crime style preferred)

A short note on how you would find and verify original bodycam footage

Your expected rate and weekly availability

A brief answer: Pick one true-crime YouTube channel and tell me what they do well and what you would improve.

title: Technical SEO & AI Search Specialist (AEO / GEO)
description:
Technical SEO & AI Search Specialist (AEO / GEO)

Part-time contractor · Remote (Philippines) · Holdline LLC

$6 to $7 USD per hour · 8 to 10 hours per week to start



The job

Holdline is a US agency serving local service businesses. We make client businesses easy for Google and AI assistants to find, understand, trust, and cite. Your first client is a US plumbing company in the Mountain Time zone: when a homeowner searches Google or asks ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, or Google AI Overviews who to call, the business should be accurately represented and, where earned, named or cited.



Local and technical SEO is the foundation; AI search visibility (AEO and GEO) is the main focus. Not a web-developer role or a daily full-time seat: you will not build the site from scratch.



Week to week



AI search (the main focus)



Build and maintain a fixed set of local buyer prompts: what a homeowner would actually ask about plumbing, emergencies, and who to call nearby



Check them on a schedule across Google AI Overviews (and AI Mode where it appears), ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini; log whether the client is named, cited, or left out, which competitors and sources appear, and whether the description is accurate



Write or brief answer-first updates to service and location pages so AI systems can retrieve and cite them: clear openings, service and location facts, FAQs, definitions, verifiable facts



Recommend third-party sources or corrections when AI answers cite other sites or get the business wrong, without promising citations will follow





Local and technical SEO (the foundation)



Monitor Google Search Console; fix indexing, coverage, and crawl issues



Improve service and location pages for local search



Maintain structured data (LocalBusiness, Service, Organization, FAQ where they fit), internal links, sitemaps, redirects, and 

consistent business information (name, address, phone, hours, service area)



Confirm pages are accessible to search and AI crawlers; flag code, speed, or form problems for a developer





Reporting

A short monthly note to the owner: what changed, what Search Console and the prompt checks show, what to do next, and what the data cannot prove. No vanity rankings, no guaranteed AI-search or citation claims





Requirements



Must-haves:

Proven local SEO results, ideally home services, with a Google Search Console work sample or case you can walk through: baseline, changes, outcome, and where the numbers came from



Hands-on AEO/GEO work you can show: a tracked prompt set, a citation or mention log (a spreadsheet is fine), or pages restructured for AI answers. You can explain the baseline, what you changed, what happened, and what you could not claim, and you know how these engines retrieve, select, and cite sources for local-service questions



Solid technical SEO: crawling, sitemaps, schema, redirects, site speed, AI crawler access



Answer-first content structuring or briefing (openings, FAQs, definitions, tables, and accurate business entities), and comfortable editing WordPress pages and SEO settings (no theme development)



Clear written English; able to work independently with a short weekly check-in





Nice to have, not gates: paid AI-visibility tools, earning third-party mentions, home-services experience. We start with a documented prompt log and free platforms.



Hours and rate

First 60 to 90 days: 8 to 10 hours per week, about 35 to 43 hours and roughly $210 to $300 a month. Then a 10 to 15 hour monthly retainer (roughly $60 to $105), reviewed at day 90. Hours grow only if another client needs the same work



A retainer, not a daily shift: Monday to Friday, async, no set 9-to-5. Slack on weekdays; occasional scheduled calls or reviews in US Mountain Time (late evening to early morning in the Philippines). No weekends unless urgent and agreed in advance

Report hours weekly; stay within the cap unless more time is approved first



Independent contractor engagement: no employee benefits or 13th-month pay. Reliable computer and internet, with a backup plan for outages





How we work

An operations manager coordinates access, hours, and check-ins; you brief a content teammate on page updates, and approved posts go through them



The owner approves anything that publishes: no live site, tracking, crawler-access, or ads changes without written approval. Development, hosting, ads, and office operations are handed off, not done by you



We handle client contact; do not contact the client unless the owner says so





First assignment (paid)



A short paid audit: a Search Console review with three prioritized fixes, plus an AI-search and citation baseline. The baseline is a documented check of a fixed prompt set across the four AI surfaces, recording whether the business is named, cited, omitted, or described inaccurately. A spreadsheet is enough. Continued work depends on its quality. We share the client site with candidates we invite to interview.



How to apply



Apply through this platform with four things:



Start your message with the words ANSWER FIRST



One local SEO case: where it started, what you changed, what happened, over what period. Real numbers and their source. Redact client names



One AI-search work sample: a prompt log, mention tracker, or restructured page



Your rate within $6 to $7, current weekly availability, and confirmation that occasional Mountain Time calls work for you





Incomplete applications are not reviewed.

title: Google Business Profile Content Manager
description:

title: Founding Local SEO Strategist (Full-Time, Remote, up to $2,500/mo)
description:
Remote · Full-time · Up to $2,500/mo to start, with a clear path up



Read this part first

Most SEO job posts are written by people who can't tell a good SEO from a bad one. This one isn't. I've run the campaigns myself, I've built the systems, and I know exactly what "good" looks like, so I'm going to be direct about who I want.



I want someone who owns it. Someone who ranks local businesses for a living, treats a stalled campaign as a puzzle instead of a reason to wait for instructions, and tells us what's happening before anyone has to ask.



I'll also be straight about the job. It's fast, it's full-time, and you'll carry real client results. If you want to be told what to do every morning, or you're looking for something on the side, this isn't it, and that's fine.



Who we are

We're a US SEO agency helping local businesses, mostly home-service contractors (roofing, HVAC, fencing, concrete, cleaning), rank at the top of Google Maps and Google search. US clients. We already have the structure: documented SOPs, a written checklist for every client, and Claude Code doing a lot of the heavy lifting.



The role

This is our founding SEO seat. You own SEO delivery for a set group of client accounts: the website pages, content, indexing and link strategy. You work a steady weekly rhythm from our written process: plan the week on Monday, work the checklist Tuesday to Friday, post what moved. You report to our operations manager and work with me on strategy.



You run our process and make it stronger. You don't throw it out and build your own. When you find a better way, you test it, write down what changed and why, and it becomes the new standard.



What you'll own

- SEO delivery for your client accounts, start to finish

- Service pages and city pages that target one keyword each, built to rank and convert

- Finding out why a ranking dropped and fixing the cause, not the symptom

- Getting new pages and links indexed, and not submitting a URL before the page is actually live

- Link building with judgment: relevant, local, natural anchors

- Taking our SOPs and making them measurably stronger, then documenting what you changed

- Using AI (Claude, APIs) so nobody does the same manual task twice



Who you are

- Native-level English. You'll write updates every day and sometimes talk to clients. Non-negotiable.

- An over-communicator. This is the one I care about most. I want too many updates, not too few. If you're stuck or behind, you say so the same day.

- A problem-solver with no ego. You hit a wall, you research it, you test your way out, then you tell us what you learned.

- Someone who stays. This is a long-term seat. I want someone I can grow with for years.



What you've actually done

- Ranked multiple local businesses into the Google Maps 3-pack and kept them there. Not "worked on." Ranked. You can walk me through the lever you pulled and the position that moved.

- Built and fixed service and city pages on real sites.

- Used AI every day and caught it when it was wrong.

- Worked on a team before. You know how to hand off, document and follow a process someone else wrote.



Quick one so I know you actually read this: what's your favorite vegetable, and why? Put the answer at the very top of your application.



What I offer

- Up to $2,500/mo to start, growing as you take on more clients and more ownership.

- A real path to running SEO here as the team grows.

- Real ownership. No bureaucracy. You own SEO results and you'll feel it.



Logistics

- Full-time, remote.

- At least 4 hours of daily overlap with US Eastern. Tell me your timezone and normal working hours in your application.

- Start date: as soon as we find the right person.



How to apply

Put your answers to these in your application. Yes, I read every one:

- Your favorite vegetable and why (from above)

- Your name and age

- What motivates you. Be brutally honest. "Money" is a fine answer if it's the true one.

- Your local SEO experience

- The coolest thing you've ever done with SEO

- One technical answer: a roofer's Google Business Profile is stuck at position 8 in the map pack. What's the first thing you'd change, and why that before anything else?

title: High-Ticket Closer (Cohort Program) / Cold Caller
description:
About the role

I'm hiring a commission-based plus base to cold call my list.

A closer to enroll junk removal and demolition business owners into my coaching program. The first cohort starts January 12, 2027.

I'm Dave Lockwood. I built Remove It Pros in Southwest Florida into a demolition company with 20,000+ jobs completed, 1,300+ five-star Google reviews and up to 130 people at peak season. The program teaches owners how to add selective demolition, flooring removal and concrete cutting, the higher-margin work most junk companies leave on the table.

Leads are warm. They come from my YouTube channel (about 73,000 subscribers), my interviews with owners and my appointment setter. You will be cold calling.

What you'll do

• Run 45-minute enrollment calls on Zoom with business owners who booked through my setter or calendar.

• Find out where their business is now, where they want it, and what's in the way, then show them whether the program fits.

• Close on the call or set a firm follow-up date. Never leave a call without a next step.

• Send payment links (full pay or payment plan) and confirm payment.

• Follow up with every "maybe" until it's a yes or a no.

• Log every call, outcome and note in HighLevel the same day.

• Turn away owners who aren't a fit. A bad enrollment costs me more than a lost sale.

• Meet with me weekly to review calls, objections and numbers.

What you get from me

You'll have everything you need to sell on day one:

• Offer sheet: price, payment plans, what's included, cohort dates, bonuses, guarantee and refund policy.

• Sales script: the call structure and the questions I ask.

• Objection guide: the 10 most common objections and how I answer them.

• Recorded calls: my own enrollment calls to study.

• Proof: my results, case studies and testimonials as they come in.

• Ideal client profile: who's a fit and who isn't, built from 35+ interviews with owners.

• Tools: HighLevel access, a Zoom account, a calendar link and payment links.

• Rules: what you can and can't promise, and no discounts beyond what's on the offer sheet.

What you need

• 1+ year closing high-ticket offers ($2,000+) over the phone or Zoom, with numbers you can show: calls taken, close rate, cash collected.

• Fluent, natural US-market English.

• Comfortable talking with blue-collar business owners: direct, no fluff, no pressure tactics.

• Experience with HighLevel or a similar CRM.

• Available for calls between 10 AM and 7 PM Eastern.

• Big plus: experience selling coaching or programs to contractors, trades or home-service owners.

Pay $4 Hour

Item

Details

Commission

5% of cash collected on every enrollment you close (final rate set in writing before you start)

Payment plans

Commission paid on each installment as it's collected

When paid

Every two weeks, after the refund window on each sale has passed

Base pay

None during the first cohort

Hours

Flexible. You take the calls on your calendar.

How to apply

Applications without all three items below won't be reviewed.

1.  A recording of a real sales call you ran (with the prospect's details removed), or a 5-minute role-play video.

2.  Your numbers from the last 90 days: calls taken, close rate, cash collected, average ticket.

3.  In three sentences: how you'd handle a junk removal owner who says, "I can't afford it right now."

Put the word DEMO as the first word of your application.

title: Medical Virtual Assistant (Fixed Salary)
description:
• Pay: USD 900 a month, fixed. This role has no commission or incentive pay.

• Shift: Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 6 PM US Eastern (10 PM to 7 AM in Manila), with some weekend shifts for coverage

• Benefits: HMO from your third month, flexible paid time off

• Where: fully remote, from a quiet room at home



A CALL, FOR EXAMPLE

Your first call of the day is to a woman in her seventies with COPD. Her health system referred her to us last week. She asks how you got her number. You explain who we are and how our team can help her stay well at home, answer her questions, and book her first visit.



THE JOB

Health systems across the US refer older patients with heart failure or COPD to us, often after a hospital stay. You call them, explain in plain words how our doctors, nurses and respiratory therapists can care for them at home, and book their first video visit.



You make 45 to 60 calls a day. Most go to voicemail, and about a dozen become real conversations. Some patients are wary, some are tired of doctors, some just want someone to listen. Your job is to help each one decide whether to join, and to get them to a first visit within a week or so. Between calls you schedule visits, keep patient records up to date and work with our clinical team.



ABOUT ANSIBLEHEALTH

AnsibleHealth is a US medical group for people living with serious heart and lung disease, such as heart failure and COPD. Health systems and health plans send us their patients, often right after a hospital stay. Our own doctors, nurse practitioners, nurses and respiratory therapists then look after them at home by video and phone: we adjust medicines, treat flare-ups early, teach patients and their families, and are on call day and night. The goal is fewer trips back to the hospital. We were founded in 2021, are backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, First Round Capital and AlleyCorp, and our team works across the United States and the Philippines.



WHAT YOU NEED



• 2 or more years on the phone in customer service or healthcare

• Comfort with clinical topics: nursing or other clinical training, or healthcare work where you talked with patients about their conditions

• Clear spoken English that a US patient understands the first time

• A quiet room, internet of 30 Mbps or faster, and a backup for outages

• Availability for this shift for the long term

A healthcare degree, US healthcare accounts, sales or appointment-setting experience, or Spanish are a plus.



This is a phone job with daily targets, not back-office or email work. If you like talking with people and helping them say yes to care, you will do well here.



HOW TO APPLY (ABOUT 15 MINUTES)



1. Apply only at https://www.ansiblehealth.com/careers/jobs/medical-virtual-assistant-fixed-salary/apply?ref=3yj4hab6 . Applications sent any other way are not reviewed.

2. Answer a few quick questions. When the form asks for the word from this posting, type LUNGS.

3. Record your voice on the form: read three lines from a real call, then answer a patient in your own words (about five minutes).

4. Give your earliest start date and the notice you owe your current employer.

If you are shortlisted, we email you a link to book a 15-minute call with our recruiter.

title: YouTube Video Editor for Vlog Content (Long-Form Vlogs + Shorts)
description:

- At least 1 year editing YouTube vlogs or long-form storytelling content (portfolio required)

- A strong sense of storytelling and retention: you know why viewers click away at minute 2 and how to stop it

- Comfortable with large files and fast turnaround (48-72 hours per vlog)

- Good written English and a reliable internet connection that can handle large uploads and downloads

- Available for a few hours each day that overlap with US Eastern time



NICE TO HAVE

- Thumbnail design (Photoshop or Canva)

- After Effects or other motion graphics tools

- Experience reading YouTube Studio analytics (audience retention, CTR)

- Experience editing for lifestyle, travel or business creators



PAY

$500-$700/month full-time, based on skill and speed. Raises after 90 days based on quality and channel growth.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Use the subject line: VLOG EDIT - [Your Name] (so we know you read the full post)

2. Send links to 2-3 YouTube vlogs you edited, and tell us what you did on each one

3. Tell us your editing software and your usual turnaround for a 15-minute vlog

4. Tell us your expected monthly rate



Shortlisted applicants will do a paid test edit: a 10-minute vlog from our raw footage.

title: Video Editor for a Documentary-Style YouTube Channel (Part-Time, Long Term)
description:
ABOUT THE CHANNEL

We are launching an English-language YouTube channel that tells the real stories behind well-known companies and brands. Videos are 10 to 15 minutes, narrated, and built on original research. We publish two a week and want one reliable editor who grows with the channel.



WHAT YOU GET FROM US FOR EVERY VIDEO

- A finished script and a recorded voiceover

- A shot list that says what goes on screen for each line

- Templates for number cards, charts, document frames and Shorts

- Image prompts in our house style

- A list of approved sources for real footage



WHAT YOU DO

- Assemble the video to the voiceover, with a picture change about every 4 to 5 seconds

- Generate illustrations from our prompts and animate cards and charts from our templates

- Add music and sound from the licensed library we provide

- Cut five Shorts from each video using our Shorts template

- Strong DaVinci Resolve or Premiere Pro skills and clean motion graphics (CapCut could work as well)

- Experience with at least one AI image generator

- Good written English and reliable communication

- A computer and internet connection that can handle 1080p projects



ONE RULE WITH NO EXCEPTIONS

Never take footage, images, graphics, music or wording from another YouTube video about the same topic, or from any channel that makes videos like ours. This includes a few seconds, a screenshot, or a clip that has been cropped, flipped or recoloured. If any of it appears in a video you deliver, the work ends that day and that video is not paid. We give you approved sources so this is easy to follow. If you are unsure about a source, ask first.



THE PROCESS AND PAY

1. Paid test: edit a 2.5 minute segment from our script, voiceover and shot list. $35, paid on delivery.

3. Ongoing: two videos a week at $100 each, with the workload and pay reviewed as the channel grows.



The goal is to go from 2 videos per week, to a full-time position in the initial 2-3 months. 



TO APPLY

Send links to two long-form videos you edited and say exactly which parts were your work. Tell us which editing software and which AI image tool you use, and how many hours a week you have.

title: Copy & Content Writer
description:
We are building Broad Republic – a new direct-to-consumer apparel brand launching in Spring 2027. Backed by a team that's done it before, we're entering a Big & Tall category we believe has been overlooked for far too long. Customers deserve better products, a stronger brand, and a world-class experience. We’re here to raise the bar.  



The Role:



We are searching for a versatile, culturally connected Copy & Content Writer who knows how to bring a brand to life through words. From commerce-driven copy to compelling editorial storytelling, you'll help define and deliver the voice of our brand across every touchpoint.



This is an opportunity to become one of the voices behind something new and exciting. As our brand storyteller, you'll play a key role in shaping how Broad Republic shows up in the world, creating the words, stories, and experiences that introduce us to our first customers and keep them coming back. From bold homepage messaging and product descriptions to campaign concepts, print materials, and thought-provoking stories exploring the intersection of style, culture, and everyday life, your words will help bring our brand vision to life.



Job Duties & Responsibilities:



1)  Commercial Copywriting & Conversion 

-Site Copy: Write and refine product descriptions, category pages, landing pages, and UX copy that clearly communicate fit, fabric, and sizing details with empathy, clarity, and style.


 Marketing: Craft compelling
 campaigns, flows, and promotional newsletters that drive engagement, community loyalty, and sales conversions. 

-Ad Copy: Develop memorable, conversion-focused ad copy and creative messaging across paid channels, translating campaign concepts, product benefits, and customer insights into impactful hooks, headlines, and calls to action that capture attention, communicate value, and drive action. 

-Social Copy: Develop thought-provoking captions and messaging for organic and paid social media platforms (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, etc.) tailored to our community. 



2)  Content Strategy & Editorial Execution 

-Brief Development: Lead the creation of comprehensive content briefs for blog posts, style guides, and cultural features that resonate with our community. 

-Editorial Articles: Pitch, write, and edit longer-form lifestyle and fashion articles that position our brand as a trusted authority for information and cultural commentary. 

-Voice & Tone Stewardship: Ensure a consistent, inclusive, and authentic brand voice across every piece of published material. 



3)  Search, Discovery & Optimization (SEO & GEO) 

-Keyword & Intent Integration: Implement strategic keyword research into site copy, product pages, and editorial pieces. Understand the role of content in the consumer acquisition funnel. 

-GEO Readiness: Optimize content structure, FAQs, and proof points to build discoverability and authority in AI-powered LLM agents, search summaries, and modern shopping recommendation engines.

-Performance Tracking: Monitor content performance to continuously refine our copy strategy for maximum rank and visibility.



Experience, Education and Designations:



-2–4+ years of professional copywriting, and content writing or journalism experience covering apparel, retail, or lifestyle consumer brands (experience writing for menswear or big & tall markets is highly welcomed).

-A portfolio demonstrating the ability to write short-form, high-converting social/email headlines alongside deeply engaging long-form articles.

-Working knowledge of modern SEO principles (on-page optimization, search intent) and an awareness of emerging Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) strategies for e-commerce shopping.

-A genuine understanding of, and empathy for, the plus-size menswear community—someone who approaches body inclusivity with respect, dignity, and a point of view.

-Comfortable working independently in a hybrid, evolving work environment, managing deadlines, and collaborating with design and marketing teams. 



Knowledge, Skills and Attributes:



-Strong command of language, grammar, storytelling, and the ability to communicate ideas clearly and creatively.

-Naturally curious, plugged into cultural conversations, emerging trends, fashion, and lifestyle.

-Understands that great content needs to serve both the brand and business objectives.

-Can effortlessly shift between promotional, editorial, educational, and conversational writing styles.

-Takes pride in accuracy, consistency, proofreading, and delivering polished, high-quality work.

-Proactively brings forward ideas, identifies opportunities, and takes ownership of content from concept through execution.

-Works effectively with creative, marketing, ecommerce, and cross-functional partners.

-Keeps up with evolving content trends, AI-powered search, emerging platforms, and new ways to engage consumers.



*Please submit your resume along with a portfolio of commercial copywriting and editorial content.

title: Workforce management
description:
Department: Customer Support Operations

Employment Type: Part-Time (20 hours per week), with potential transition to Full-Time

Work Arrangement: Remote



We are looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive Support Operations Administrator to oversee workforce scheduling, headcount monitoring, attendance tracking, and administrative coordination within our Customer Support team.



This position initially requires 20 hours per week, with the possibility of transitioning into a full-time role as operational requirements expand.



The primary responsibility is to establish and maintain an organized scheduling and workforce planning system, ensure accurate daily headcount, coordinate attendance and shift adjustments, and support the overall administrative needs of the department.



The ideal candidate is someone who can build processes from scratch, maintain accurate records, work independently, and coordinate effectively with multiple teams across different time zones.



Key Responsibilities



1. Workforce Scheduling and Planning

*Develop, implement, and maintain a centralized workforce scheduling system.

*Establish a standardized scheduling process using one master roster, one scheduling template, and a consistent weekly submission deadline.

*Prepare and maintain weekly and monthly team schedules, ensuring appropriate staffing coverage across all shifts.

*Monitor staffing requirements and identify potential scheduling gaps or headcount shortages.

*Coordinate shift assignments, rest days, weekend coverage, and schedule adjustments.

*Ensure scheduling policies and procedures are consistently followed.

*Coordinate with team leads to ensure schedules are submitted, reviewed, and finalized within the established deadlines.



2. Daily Headcount and Attendance Management

*Maintain accurate daily headcount records, including agents, team leads, shift leads, and other operational personnel.

*Monitor daily attendance, absences, tardiness, and schedule adherence.

*Coordinate with team leads regarding attendance discrepancies and staffing concerns.

*Maintain organized attendance and workforce records for reporting and reference.

*Ensure staffing reports accurately reflect the team’s actual availability.

*Identify attendance patterns and recurring staffing concerns and escalate them to management when necessary.

title: Bookkeeper (Quickbooks Online)
description:
# Part-Time Bookkeeper (QuickBooks Online)



### Job Overview

### Key Responsibilities

- Prepare and send invoices for monthly retainers and project-based services.

title: Amazon Virtual Assistant – Inventory & Account Monitoring Specialist
description:
Job Title: Amazon Virtual Assistant – Inventory & Account Monitoring Specialist



Employment Type: Full-Time  

Work Setup: Remote  

Schedule: 9:00 PM – 6:00 AM Philippine Time  

Department: E-commerce / Amazon Operations



Job Overview:



We are looking for a detail-oriented and reliable Amazon Virtual Assistant to support our e-commerce operations, particularly in inventory monitoring, removal order tracking, customer review monitoring, and product performance reporting.



The ideal candidate must have hands-on experience with Amazon Seller Central, strong analytical skills, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to follow established Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).



Experience with Walmart Seller Center is also a plus. Applicants who have experience managing both Amazon and Walmart accounts are highly encouraged to apply.



This role requires someone who can accurately collect, verify, organize, and report marketplace data while identifying discrepancies and escalating potential issues to management.



Key Responsibilities:



1. Amazon Customer Review Monitoring

- Monitor customer reviews across assigned Amazon ASINs.

- Review and classify customer feedback, particularly new 1-star and 2-star reviews.

- Identify potential violations of Amazon Community Guidelines and Customer Review Policies.

- Collect screenshots and supporting evidence for qualifying policy violations.

- Report reviews through Amazon-approved reporting channels when justified.

- Contact Amazon Community Help when appropriate and follow up on reported cases.

- Monitor cases and escalate to Seller Support if no response is received within 48 hours.

- Maintain an accurate review reporting and removal tracking log.

- Route legitimate product complaints and recurring feedback to the appropriate team.



2. Amazon Removal Order Tracking

- Generate and review Amazon Removal Order Detail reports covering the last 365 days.

- Identify removal orders and review all shipped units.

- Record tracking numbers, shipment dates, product details, Ionic colors, and bundle quantities.

- Update the Removal Google Sheet with accurate shipment information.

- Monitor UPS and other carrier tracking statuses.

- Update shipments as IN TRANSIT or DELIVERED.

- Notify the assigned team member when shipments are delivered.

- Reconcile expected versus received quantities.

- Identify missing or incorrect units and prepare supporting evidence.

- Open Amazon Support cases for confirmed removal shipment shortages.

- Create and monitor ClickUp tasks until each issue is resolved.



3. Amazon FBA Inventory Monitoring and Reporting

- Generate Amazon Inventory Ledger Reports through Seller Central.

- Configure reports using the correct date range, summary view, country-level aggregation, and daily reporting.

- Download and analyze CSV inventory reports.

- Filter inventory by SELLABLE disposition.

- Organize inventory data by ASIN and date.

- Calculate total packs and individual physical units using the correct product multipliers.

- Identify and consolidate multiple active SKUs under the same ASIN when applicable.

- Update the Master Inventory Tracker accurately.

- Verify category subtotals and grand totals.

- Identify and explain inventory fluctuations caused by inbound shipments, FC transfers, and customer returns.



4. Amazon Ionic Inventory Reconciliation

- Monitor all assigned Ionic products and variations across Amazon listings.

- Check every relevant ASIN and SKU, including Black, Blue, Green, and other Ionic variations.

- Record inventory quantities across relevant Amazon inventory statuses.

- Calculate the total number of individual Ionic pieces currently held by Amazon.

- Ensure bundle quantities are converted into individual units correctly.

- Double-check all figures and identify missing or duplicated listings.

- Prepare accurate inventory breakdowns and final reports for management.



5. Amazon Best Sellers Rank (BSR) Monitoring

- Monitor all assigned Ionic Black Amazon listings daily.

- Record main category and subcategory BSR rankings.

- Update the shared BSR tracking Google Sheet.

- Maintain consistent daily reporting before the required deadline.

- Monitor ranking trends and identify significant changes.

- Immediately escalate any listing that drops more than 5,000 BSR positions within one day.

- Include previous versus current rankings and relevant observations in escalation reports.



6. Walmart Marketplace Support (Plus)

- Assist with Walmart Seller Center monitoring and account management when assigned.

- Monitor Walmart inventory levels and product availability.

- Assist with order and fulfillment monitoring.

- Help identify inventory discrepancies and account-related issues.

- Maintain accurate tracking sheets and marketplace reports.

- Escalate account or operational issues to management.



7. Reporting and Administrative Responsibilities

- Maintain accurate Google Sheets and tracking logs.

- Document all completed actions, findings, and unresolved issues.

- Provide clear and timely updates to management.

- Create and monitor ClickUp tasks for pending issues and escalations.

- Follow established company SOPs and reporting deadlines.

- Coordinate with the appropriate teams when discrepancies or operational issues arise.



Qualifications and Requirements



- Previous experience working as an Amazon Virtual Assistant.

- Hands-on experience with Amazon Seller Central.

- Knowledge of FBA inventory management and reporting.

- Experience handling removal orders and shipment tracking.

- Familiarity with Amazon customer review policies and reporting procedures.

- Experience with Google Sheets, Excel, and data reconciliation.

- Familiarity with ClickUp or other project management tools.

- Strong attention to detail and numerical accuracy.

- Excellent written English communication skills.

- Ability to follow detailed SOPs independently.

- Strong organizational and problem-solving skills.

- Reliable internet connection and a dedicated work setup.



Preferred Qualifications



- Experience managing multiple Amazon ASINs and SKUs.

- Knowledge of Amazon FBA inventory reconciliation.

- Experience handling Amazon Seller Support cases.

- Familiarity with inventory tracking and reporting systems.

- Experience working with US-based e-commerce brands.

- Experience with Walmart Seller Center, including inventory management, order monitoring, and reporting, is a plus.

- Applicants with experience managing both Amazon and Walmart accounts are highly encouraged to apply.



Working Schedule:

- 9:00 PM – 6:00 AM Philippine Time.

- Must be available during the required working hours.



Performance Expectations (KPIs)



Performance will be evaluated based on:

- Accuracy of removal order and tracking records.

- Proper documentation of customer review policy concerns.

- Timely reporting and escalation of inventory discrepancies.

title: Technical Support Specialist
description:
• Pay: USD 950 a month base, plus performance incentives. Our top performers take home about USD 1,100 to 1,200 a month.

• Shift: Monday to Friday, US Eastern daytime in staggered shifts between 8 AM and 8 PM, with some weekend shifts and on-call turns (a night shift in Manila)

• Benefits: HMO from your third month, flexible paid time off

• Where: fully remote



THE JOB

Our patients are mostly older adults at home in the US with heart failure or COPD. They see their care team by video on a tablet we send them, and their pulse oximeter and blood pressure monitor send readings to us. When something stops working, you are the person who fixes it, often by walking a patient who is not comfortable with technology through it one step at a time.



You take about 50 calls a day from patients and clinicians: a tablet that will not join a visit, a device that stopped sending readings, a clinician who needs help in Athenahealth. You own each problem until it is solved, and you write clear reports for our engineers when something needs a fix on their side.



ABOUT ANSIBLEHEALTH

AnsibleHealth is a US medical group for people living with serious heart and lung disease, such as heart failure and COPD. Health systems and health plans send us their patients, often right after a hospital stay. Our own doctors, nurse practitioners, nurses and respiratory therapists then look after them at home by video and phone: we adjust medicines, treat flare-ups early, teach patients and their families, and are on call day and night. The goal is fewer trips back to the hospital. We were founded in 2021, are backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, First Round Capital and AlleyCorp, and our team works across the United States and the Philippines.



WHAT YOU NEED



• 2 or more years in technical or customer support where you solved technology problems for customers

• Tech savviness: you pick up new devices and tools quickly (Android tablets, Zoom, Google Workspace)

• A friendly, patient way of helping older adults in the US, in clear English

• Reliable high-speed internet and availability for this shift for the long term

Experience with Samsung Knox or another device-management tool, remote monitoring devices, Athenahealth, or an issue tracker such as GitLab is a plus.

We are a residential cleaning company based in North Carolina, USA, and we have been serving Triangle-area families since 2016. We currently serve over 57 recurring residential clients and we are growing. We are hiring a full-time, remote Sales and Customer Service Representative to manage our residential clients and convert new leads into booked recurring services.

This is not a data entry job. This is not a passive support role. You will be the first voice a potential client hears, and you will be the ongoing relationship owner for our existing clients. If you are someone who takes ownership of your results, stays on top of follow-up without being reminded, and genuinely enjoys talking to people and solving problems — read on.



What You Will Do

You will respond to all inbound residential leads and conduct discovery calls to understand what clients need. You will close recurring cleaning bookings, not one-time services. You will manage post-service check-ins with existing clients, handle rescheduling and service concerns, and work to keep our clients happy and retained. You will log all activity in our CRM (GoHighLevel) and submit daily and weekly reports to ownership. You will also request Google reviews from satisfied clients and support our referral program.

This is a full-time role, Monday through Friday, Eastern Standard Time (EST). You must be available and online during these hours. This means your working hours will be in the evening and nighttime in the Philippines. Please only apply if this schedule works for you.



What We Need From You

You need at least two years of experience in sales, customer service, or client relations — service industry experience is preferred. You need a strong, clear phone voice. You need to be comfortable following up consistently without dropping the ball. You need experience using a CRM or similar platform. GoHighLevel experience is a big plus. You must have a dedicated home workspace, stable and fast internet, a reliable computer, and a headset. You must be available during US Eastern Time business hours.



What We Offer

This is a full-time remote position with a competitive base salary and a performance bonus tied to your conversion rate, client retention, and Google review activity. We are a stable, growing company. We do not micromanage. We expect you to own your results and show up ready to work every day.



Our Culture

We operate on five core values: Show Up and Follow Through. Do the Right Thing Even When No One Is Looking. Own Your Results. Support the Team. Protect the Brand. If these values match how you already work, you will fit here.

title: Senior Amazon Marketplace Growth Manager
description:
SENIOR AMAZON MARKETPLACE GROWTH MANAGER



Salary: $3,500 – $5,000 USD / month (Base) + Aggressive Annual Performance Bonus tied to KPI achievement

Remote | Full-time |



*****ABOUT THE ROLE*****



ARE YOU THE SENIOR AMAZON MARKETPLACE GROWTH MANAGER WE’RE LOOKING FOR? 



Intent Brands operates SurviveX (first-aid and preparedness products) and Aerotrunk (luggage).

Website: 
/

: 



We are seeking an exceptional, numbers-driven Senior Amazon Marketplace Growth Manager to take

end-to-end commercial and operational ownership of our unified Amazon Seller Central account.



Currently generating approximately $20 million in trailing 12-month revenue, our portfolio consists of two

category-leading brands: one in First Aid & Emergency Preparedness and the other in Travel Accessories.

Both brands operate under a single Seller Central account, presenting significant opportunities for catalog

expansion, advertising efficiency, and cross-merchandising.



In this role, you are not simply managing listings. You are the primary owner of the channel’s P&L. You will

make high-stakes executive decisions backed by financial rigor, driving profitable top-line and bottom-line

expansion. You will orchestrate advertising strategy, listing conversion optimization, promotional calendars,

external traffic capture, and strategic relationships (including our Amazon SAS Core partner).



******** KEY RESPONSIBILITIES********



1. P&L Ownership & Financial Leadership

• Commercial Accountability: Own the Amazon channel P&L end-to-end, steering margin health,

revenue velocity, and net contribution.

• Cost & Margin Decomposition: Deeply analyze unit economics, Landed COGS, Amazon fee

structures (FBA fulfillment, referral, storage, aged inventory surcharges), and overall contribution margin

to inform pricing and operational decisions.

• Capital & TACoS Allocation: Determine and allocate target TACoS (Total Advertising Cost of Sales)

percentage points across specific product lines and ad formats to maintain healthy profitability while

unlocking incremental growth.



2. Advertising Strategy & External Traffic Leverage

• PPC Team Collaboration: Partner closely with our internal PPC Manager to execute high-performing

ad campaigns across all inventory formats:

• Sponsored Products (SP)

• Sponsored Brands (SB)

• Sponsored Brand Video (SBV)

• Sponsored Display (SD)

• TACoS Discipline: Ensure campaign efficiency aligns strictly with overarching P&L margin targets and

inventory lifecycle stages.

• External Traffic & Spillover Synergy: Quantify and leverage halo traffic originating from our

direct-to-consumer (Shopify) marketing channels. Devise strategies to capture, attribute, and accelerate

this external demand to boost Amazon organic rank and BSR velocity.



3. Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) & Listing Architecture

• Systematic CRO Audits: Regularly audit existing product detail pages (PDPs) across both brand

catalogs to identify friction points and conversion leakage.

• Hypothesis-Driven Testing: Develop structured CRO hypotheses for creative assets, infographics,

Premium A+ Content, copy, and video.

• Creative Collaboration: Partner with our Creative Designer to produce conversion-optimized creative

assets based on your strategic briefs.

• A/B Experimentation: Design, execute, and monitor iterative A/B tests (via Amazon Manage Your

Experiments and third-party tooling) to systematically identify winning listing iterations that maximize

conversion rate and session value.

• Search Query Performance (SQP) Optimization: Utilize Amazon SQP and Brand Analytics data to

reverse-engineer customer search intent, refining titles, bullet points, backend search terms, and

descriptions for organic dominance.



4. Merchandising, Cross-Selling & Promotional Strategy

• Parent/Child ASIN Architecture: Capitalize on our high-performing cross-selling parent ASIN

structures to maximize basket size, customer lifetime value, and cross-brand discovery.

• Deal Cadence & Execution: Plan, schedule, and execute high-impact promotional events, including

7-Day / Best Deals and Prime Exclusive Deals (PEDs).

• Deal Post-Mortems: Rigorously evaluate every promotional event to assess whether it delivered

genuine incremental velocity while safeguarding net contribution margins.

• Amazon Storefront Optimization: Continuously evaluate Storefront performance and landing page

entry points. Optimize brand narrative, user navigation, and the path to purchase to reduce bounce rates

and maximize average order value (AOV).



5. Technical Operations & Strategic Escalations

• Catalog Health & Compliance: Work in tandem with our Amazon Technical Specialist to proactively

maintain account health, resolve listing suppressions, remediate stranded inventory, and expedite case

resolution.

• Amazon SAS Core Management: Serve as the primary operational and strategic liaison with our

dedicated Amazon SAS Core representative, leveraging this relationship for new beta programs,

commercial growth opportunities, and critical issue escalations.





********CANDIDATE QUALIFICATIONS********



**Required Experience:**



1.) High-Volume Track Record: 5+ years of hands-on Amazon Seller Central management, with proven

success steering high-volume, 8-figure accounts ($10M to $20M+ annual run rate).



2.) P&L Fluency: Thorough understanding of e-commerce financial models, contribution margin analysis,

fee structures, and TACoS/ROAS balance.



3.) Advanced Amazon Tooling: Mastery of Amazon Brand Analytics, Search Query Performance (SQP),

Manage Your Experiments, Category Insight reports, and the full Amazon Ads console.



4.) Analytical & Data-Driven: Exceptional analytical capability with advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills;

ability to turn granular marketplace data into decisive commercial action.



5.) Strategic CRO Expertise: Demonstrated experience developing creative briefs, formulating conversion

hypotheses, and executing split-testing protocols.



6.) Autonomous Leadership: Executive presence and proactive mindset capable of managing

cross-functional contributors (PPC specialists, technical support, creative designers).



**Preferred Qualifications**

1.) Direct experience in consumer physical products within the Emergency Preparedness / First Aid or

Travel Gear / Accessories categories.

2.) Familiarity with omni-channel dynamics, specifically the interaction between Shopify D2C advertising

and Amazon organic lift.

3.) Experience managing Amazon SAS Core or equivalent dedicated account management programs.



********HOW TO APPLY********

To apply, please submit:



1.) Links to your Updated Resume & Portfolio

2.) A brief Cover Note or Loom Video addressing:

- The annual revenue scale of the largest Amazon Seller Central account you have personally managed.

- How you approach calculating and managing TACoS allocation across Sponsored Products, Sponsored

Brands, and Sponsored Display within a strict P&L framework.

- One specific example of a successful listing CRO experiment or promotional strategy you designed and

scaled on Amazon.



******COMPENSATION & BENEFITS******



• Base Salary: $3,500 to $5,000 USD per month, commensurate with experience and past scale

managed.

• Performance Bonus: Aggressive annual cash bonus tied directly to hitting clear, pre-agreed P&L and

growth KPIs.

• Work Arrangement: 100% Remote / Distributed team.

• Impact & Ownership: High degree of executive autonomy over a substantial, mature $20M business

line with direct exposure to brand leadership.



WE CAN’T WAIT TO REVIEW YOUR APPLICATION AND DISCUSS HOW WE CAN SUPPORT YOUR STRATEGIC VISION! 🏆🔥

description:

Only Applications sent through this link will be considered: 





About us



We are a property management company in Los Angeles. We run the business on our own software: leasing, maintenance, inspections, move-ins and move-outs, tenant and owner portals, staff hours, payroll and accounting. We build it with Claude, an AI that writes the code.



The role:

You run the day-to-day development of that software. You d

You don't need to code. You do need to know accounting and how business systems are set up, well enough to spot when a number is wrong and find out why.

Write clear instructions for Claude to build features and fix problems.

Test every change in our test environment before it goes live.

Nice to have:

Daily use of Claude, ChatGPT or Copilot at work.

US property management accounting: owner statements, security deposits, trust reconciliations.

Business systems analyst or ERP consultant background.

Payroll experience (Gusto or similar).



What the first 90 days will look like:

Days 1-30: learn the software and how to work with Claude, starting with small fixes.

By day 90: own bug reports and staff questions end to end, shipping fixes across the system.



Requirements: 

Degree in accounting, finance or accounting information systems.

Solid accounting knowledge: reconciliations, AP and AR. Trust accounting a plus.

Experience setting up or running a business system: accounting software, ERP, CRM, or property management software (Buildium, AppFolio, Yardi).

Excellent written English.

Promotion path

Company Christmas gift

**Classical Music | Nonprofit Arts Organization | Remote**

**Salary:** Negotiable, depending on qualifications and experience  

**Initial Probationary Period:** 3 months



We are looking for a highly organized, proactive, creative, and tech-savvy Artist Management & Executive Assistant to work directly with an internationally active classical concert pianist and a New York-based nonprofit arts organization.



We are seeking someone who can work independently, identify new opportunities, take initiative, and gradually assume increasing responsibility.



Recent university graduates and early-career professionals are encouraged to apply.



## Key Responsibilities



### 1. Artist Management & International Concert Outreach — Primary Responsibility



- Research international concert opportunities, music festivals, concert series, cultural institutions, embassies, and performing arts organizations.

- Proactively contact potential concert presenters and propose performances.

- Research universities, conservatories, and music departments offering guest artist programs, paid performances, artist residencies, master classes, and lecture-recitals.

- Identify opportunities offering artist fees, honoraria, travel reimbursement, or accommodation, as well as valuable unpaid professional engagements.

- Prepare personalized professional
s, concert proposals, and promotional materials.

- Organize artist biographies, photographs, concert programs, reviews, and performance videos.

- Maintain a database of international contacts, opportunities, applications, and follow-up dates.

- Follow up consistently with potential concert presenters.

- Develop long-term professional relationships with concert presenters and academic institutions.



### 2. Nonprofit Administration, Grants & Educational Programs



- Research grants and funding opportunities for the organization.

- Assist with preparing grant applications and reports.

- Research U.S. government funding, educational programs, and contracting opportunities.

- Assist with government registrations, applications, and renewals.

- Support the development and expansion of school music programs.

- Research and contact public and private schools.

- Assist with school vendor registrations and government-funded educational opportunities.

- Monitor applications, deadlines, and correspondence.



### 3. YouTube, Digital Media & Technical Support



- Manage and develop the artist's YouTube channel.

- Edit concert recordings and create individual performance videos from longer recordings.

- Prepare video titles, descriptions, and thumbnails.

- Upload and organize digital content.

- Maintain an organized archive of photographs, videos, press materials, and concert programs.

- Use AI and other digital tools to improve productivity.

- Provide general technical and digital support.



### 4. Executive Administration & Travel Coordination



- Coordinate international travel arrangements, including flights, hotels, and ground transportation.

- Communicate and negotiate with concert organizers, venues, hotels, and service providers.

- Prepare detailed travel itineraries.

- Coordinate concert logistics, rehearsals, accommodations, and transportation.

- Manage professional calendars, appointments, and deadlines.

- Assist with professional correspondence, contracts, invoices, and administrative documents.

- Monitor reservations, schedule changes, and travel-related arrangements.

- Anticipate upcoming administrative and logistical needs.



## Qualifications



- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Strong educational background.

- Excellent research, communication, and organizational skills.

- Ability to write professional and persuasive
s.

- Ability to work independently and take initiative.

- Strong attention to detail and reliable follow-up.

- Proficiency in Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, spreadsheets, and cloud storage.

- Familiarity with AI tools and basic video editing.

- Ability to learn new technologies and digital platforms.

- Reliable internet connection.



A university degree in **Arts Management, Music Business, Creative Industries Management, Performing Arts Administration, Communications, Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field** is highly desirable.



Knowledge of classical music, nonprofit administration, grant writing, or artist management is a significant advantage.



## What We Are Looking For



We are not looking for someone who simply completes assigned tasks. We are looking for a motivated professional who can independently identify opportunities, suggest new ideas, solve problems, and contribute to the growth of both an international concert career and a nonprofit arts organization.



The ideal candidate is someone who is proactive, resourceful, persistent, intellectually curious, and interested in building a long-term professional relationship.



This position offers an opportunity to gain international experience in artist management, classical music, cultural diplomacy, nonprofit administration, and arts education.



## How to Apply



Please provide:



1. Your CV or resume.

2. A brief introduction explaining why you are interested in this position.

3. Your educational background and relevant experience.

4. Your expected monthly salary in USD.

5. Your availability and preferred working hours.

6. A short, 1–2 minute video introduction in English explaining why you believe you would be a strong candidate for this position.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a brief practical assignment and attend an online interview.

title: Sales Operations & Process Specialist
description:
ABC Home Buyers | U.S. residential real estate investment company



The opportunity

We are hiring a sales-minded systems designer who can take an unclear operational problem, diagnose what is actually wrong, recommend a practical solution, and guide it through testing. You will improve the processes behind our seller acquisition team—not simply maintain a CRM or follow a task list.



What you will own:

- Diagnose bottlenecks in lead contact, qualification, follow-up, handoffs, and pipeline conversion.

- Design simple, usable sales workflows and decision rules; reduce unnecessary steps and complexity.

- Translate approved workflows into CRM requirements, templates, automations, and operating instructions.

- Coordinate implementation with our execution coordinator; test with the lead manager and refine.

- Present recommendations with clear reasoning, trade-offs, and the few decisions requiring CEO approval.



You may be a fit if you:

- Have personally designed and improved sales processes—not just implemented someone else’s instructions.

- Understand how sales teams work: lead response, qualification, follow-up discipline, and conversion.

- Can turn ambiguity into a clear recommendation and practical workflow with limited supervision.

- Can work confidently with CRMs, automation tools, spreadsheets, and process documentation.

- Communicate clearly in English and have experience supporting U.S.-facing sales teams.

- Real estate acquisitions experience is preferred, not required. REsimpli experience is helpful, not required. We value sound judgment and simplicity more than a long software list.



Engagement & success

- Start at approximately 10 hours/week on a 30-day paid pilot. Schedule requires reasonable overlap with U.S. Eastern business hours. Hours may expand if results justify it. Success means a meaningful operational problem moves from diagnosis to a tested improvement with minimal CEO design time.



How to apply

- Submit a résumé or relevant work history and a brief written example (150–250 words) of a sales-process problem you personally diagnosed and redesigned. Explain the problem, your decision, what changed, and how you verified the result. Include your hourly rate, availability, time zone, and CRM platforms used. looking for a sharp, dependable Scheduler / Office Coordinator to run our day-to-day scheduling and family/nurse

communication desk.

You'll work alongside our automation — the system prepares the schedules, flags the changes, logs the calls, and builds

the tickets. Your job is the human side: review and confirm what the system prepares, make the calls, keep families and

nurses in the loop, and stay on top of the moving pieces so nothing falls through the cracks.

keep the calendar accurate.



* Supervisory visits: schedule required nurse supervisory (SV) visits on cadence and send the reminders.



* Calls & texts: handle inbound and outbound calls and texts with families and nurses — return missed calls promptly,

confirm appointments, answer scheduling questions.



* Ticketing: own the request queue — log every family/nurse request, follow up, and close it out.



* Timesheet coordination: chase missing shift notes and timesheets and flag discrepancies (the system helps surface

these).



* Documentation: keep everything organized and up to date in our systems (CareBravo, ClickUp).



!!! Important — this is a phone-heavy, English-first role. You'll be talking to American families and nurses every day. Excellent

spoken and written English is required and will be tested in the interview. Dependability during U.S. Eastern hours is non-

negotiable.

*Excellent spoken and written English — clear, warm, professional on the phone

*Strong organization and attention to detail; able to juggle many moving pieces without dropping any

*Reliable and available during U.S. Eastern business hours

*Comfortable working alongside software/AI — reviewing and confirming what the system prepares, not fighting it

*Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet workspace, and a good headset

*Home-care, home-health, or medical scheduling experience

*Experience with scheduling / EVV software (CareBravo, or similar)





Bonus:

*Experience working with a U.S. company or in U.S. healthcare / Medicaid

*Customer-service or call-center background

*Experience with ClickUp or a similar ticketing / task tool







How to apply:

plus brief answers to:

1. Describe your scheduling or coordination experience.

title: Appointment Setter (DM + Follow-Up) – Salary + Commission – Long-Term
description:
ABOUT VIDEO CEO

Video CEO is a coaching program that teaches people how to build a business offering content creation and paid ad services to local businesses. We run a fast-moving sales operation: leads come in from our content and ads every day, and they need to be contacted, qualified, and booked onto sales calls quickly.



We're hiring a full-time Appointment Setter to own that process. This is a long-term role on a growing team, not a short gig.



THE ROLE IN ONE SENTENCE

You turn new leads into booked sales calls, and make sure they actually show up.



WHY SPEED TO LEAD MATTERS

A lead contacted within 5 minutes is far more likely to book than one contacted an hour later. In this role, speed is everything. When a lead comes in, you're on it. When someone replies, you reply. When someone goes quiet, you follow up. Leads don't sit.



WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY TO DAY

- Reach out to new leads fast through DMs (Instagram and other platforms), text, and our CRM

- Have real, natural conversations. Ask good questions, find out what the lead wants, and see if they're a fit

- Handle common questions and objections and guide the conversation toward booking a call

- Book qualified leads directly onto the sales calendar

- Follow up consistently with leads who go quiet: day 1, day 3, day 7 and beyond. Most bookings come from follow-up

- Send confirmations and reminders so leads show up to their calls

- Re-book no-shows and cancellations quickly

- Keep the CRM clean and organized: every lead tagged, every conversation logged, every next step clear

- Report your numbers daily (conversations, appointments booked, show rate)

- Give feedback to the team on what leads are saying so we can improve our messaging



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

- New leads get a response within minutes during your shift

- No lead falls through the cracks. Everyone gets followed up with

- Your calendar is full of qualified calls

- Your booked calls actually show up

- You hit your daily and weekly booking targets without being chased



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- You genuinely love DMing, having conversations, and booking appointments. This should feel like your thing

- Excellent written English. You sound like a real person, not a script or a bot

- Very organized. You track everything and always know where every lead stands

- Self-managed. You don't need to be checked on, reminded, or micromanaged. You see what needs to be done and do it

- Fast and responsive. You don't let messages sit

- Reliable, with a stable internet connection and a quiet place to work

- Hungry to earn. You like that commission rewards your effort

- Looking for a long-term home, not something temporary





THIS IS NOT FOR YOU IF

- You need someone telling you what to do every hour

- You're slow to respond or let conversations go cold

- You're disorganized or forget to follow up

- You're looking for an easy, low-effort job



PAY AND GROWTH

- Starting: $350/month base salary + 5% commission on every deal that closes from your booked calls

- 90-day evaluation: if you perform, your base goes up to about $650/month + 5% commission

- Commission is uncapped. The more you book and the more that close, the more you earn

- Long-term growth opportunities as the company scales



WHAT WE GIVE YOU

- Proven resources, assets, and scripts/frameworks so you're not starting from scratch

- Full training on our offer, our process, and how we talk to leads

- A clear system to follow and a team that wants you to win

- You bring the work ethic. We bring everything else



HOW TO APPLY

To be considered, your application must:

1. Start with the words "SPEED TO LEAD" (so we know you read the full post)

2. Tell us about your appointment setting, DM setting, or sales experience (if any)

3. Tell us roughly how many appointments you've booked in a week in past roles (if applicable)

4. Tell us why you'd be great at this role i



Applications that don't follow these instructions will not be reviewed.

title: Senior PPC Manager & Brand Growth Strategist
description:
This is not a campaign-execution job. As a Senior PPC Manager you grow brands, oversee client accounts, and lead the way our team works with AI: building the tools and processes that take over repetitive work, and making sure what they produce is right. We are looking for someone who thinks, sees the bigger picture, and makes the whole team better.



🟢 About Growster ⚫️

Growster is a boutique Amazon growth agency based in Germany, founded by former aggregator brand owners. We work with 7- and 8-figure brands in the EU, UK and US. Our PPC Managers are also the account managers: they own the account and the client relationship. And we are moving our whole way of working to AI-assisted workflows that our own team designs, builds and checks.

🔘What you will do

✦Own a portfolio of brands end to end: growth, profit, margin, TACOS and the P&L, not only the ad console.

✦Go beyond bid management. Connect PPC with organic rank, listing, images, CTR, CVR, pricing, stock and promotions, and flag when the problem is not PPC at all.

✦Design and build AI-assisted tools and processes that optimize our workflows and improve the ones we already have, and get the team using them.

✦Oversee accounts with a sharp eye. Check AI output before it reaches a client or an account, correct what is wrong, and own the result.

✦Put analysis, prevention and growth ahead of busywork: spot problems before they show up in the numbers, fix the cause, and add a check so it does not happen again.

✦Lead client communication: clear, proactive and honest, including client calls, decisions and hard news. Share wins, problems and plans before the client asks.

✦Work as part of the team and raise its level: help teammates do things on their own, mentor newer PPC managers, share what you learn and build, and disagree openly and constructively. This matters as much as your own results.

🔘The person we are looking for

✦Analytical. You start from the data and you know which numbers matter.

✦High-agency. You see what needs doing and do it, without waiting to be told.

✦Holistic. You think about the whole brand, not one channel.

✦AI-sharp. You build with AI and you catch it when it is wrong.

✦Honest. You say what is really happening, to the client and to us, including your own mistakes.

✦Collaborative and coachable. You make the people around you better, and you take feedback well.

🔘Who we are not looking for

🚫Checklist-only operators who follow steps without asking why.

🚫Yes-men. We want people who push back with reasons.

🚫Siloed specialists who only look at the ad console.

🚫Vanity-metric chasers who report impressions while profit slips.

🚫People who measure their value in hours and task lists. We do not need a daily "here is everything I did" report. We need the right things done and the wrong things prevented.

🚫Relays for AI. If you pass on what an AI says without checking it, this is not the role for you: every output that reaches a client or an account is yours.

🚫Part-time or freelance arrangements. This role is full-time.

🔘What success looks like after 6 months

✦You run a portfolio of brands end to end, and the clients see measurable growth.

✦At least one AI-assisted tool or process you built is used by the whole team.

✦Problems on your accounts are caught and prevented before clients notice them.

✦Teammates and clients come to you as a trusted voice.

🔘What you bring

✦3+ years owning Amazon accounts, with growth you can prove: case studies with numbers, ideally on 7- or 8-figure brands.

✦AI workflows or tools you built (with Claude, ChatGPT, automations, scripts or sheets) that changed how you or your team work, and how you check what they produce.

✦Analytical depth: Search Query Performance, search-term and placement data, bulk files, spreadsheets, and P&L thinking (break-even ACOS, TACOS, margin).

✦Strong command of the levers around PPC: SEO and keywords, listing and image content, pricing, inventory and profitability.

✦Excellent written and spoken client communication in English.

🔘What we offer

✦Salary: $1,300 to $2,300 per month (negotiable).

✦Full-time and fully remote, with flexible hours judged on results. We need a working overlap with German business hours for team and client calls.

✦A lean team that builds and shares its own AI tools.

🔘How to apply

✦Record a 5-minute intro video (Loom or similar) covering: who you are and which role you are applying for, why Growster, and your experience (challenges, meaningful projects, where you want to grow).

✦Take the free Mensa Norway IQ test at 
 and keep a screenshot of your score. It is information we collect, never a pass or fail filter.

✦Fill in the application form at 
 and upload your resume as a PDF.

❗️About AI and writing. Some questions ask you to work with your preferred AI tool; for those, paste the whole chat, because how you steer and check the AI is what we look at. Everywhere else, write in your own words. Voice-to-text such as Wispr Flow is fine, but avoid using any grammar correction function from these tools.

✦Applications sent any other way than the form are not reviewed. It is the first test of reading instructions. Do not use any polish/grammar correction in your responses aside from AI tasks❗️

🔘Our process

✦Application (above). We review within 5 business days.

✦Audit test: an integrated audit of an anonymized account covering PPC, listing health, Search Query Performance and P&L. Materials provided.

✦Interview: you walk us through your audit as if we were the client, and we talk about how you work with a team.

✦Final interview and offer.

✦End to end this usually takes 2 to 3 weeks. No unpaid trial work on live accounts, no personality tests, no coding tests, no reference call

title: Senior Accountant – Vacation Rental & Trust Accounting (US Real Estate)
description:
ABOUT US

We're a fast-growing vacation rental management company in the North Georgia mountains (USA). We manage short-term rental cabins for homeowners, run our own portfolio of rental properties, and are scaling from 10+ homes toward 100+. We're a lean, entrepreneurial team that runs on modern systems, automation and AI, and we expect every person on the team to own their seat.



We're not looking for someone to just "do the books." We want an accountant who builds, improves, and helps us make better decisions with the numbers.



THE ROLE

You'll own accounting for three related US companies: a property management company (with an owner trust account), a real estate company that owns short-term rentals, and a holding company. You'll close the books, reconcile trust funds, prepare owner statements, and turn reports into insights the founders use to run the business.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

Books and close

- Classify and reconcile all transactions in QuickBooks Online at least 3x per week; books always match the bank

- Deliver weekly financial reports every Friday and full monthly packages by the 5th, including month-end journal entries (depreciation, prepaid amortization, accruals)

- Track results by property using classes, so every home has its own P&L



Trust and owner accounting

- Manage the owner trust account: monthly reconciliation, owner balances, amounts due to/from owners, and fees moved from trust to operating

- Prepare monthly owner statements and payouts in our property management system (Hospitable), tied out to QuickBooks

- Book owner pass-through costs (supplies, repairs, trash) correctly as reimbursables, not income

- Prepare monthly lodging/hotel-motel tax figures for county filings



Insights and decisions

- Don't just send reports. Tell us what changed, why, and what we should do about it

- Flag margin issues, unusual spend, cash timing, and properties underperforming

- Build and maintain cash flow projections



Build and improve

- Find at least one way each week to make our financial reporting faster, cleaner, or more useful

- Use AI tools (we use Claude daily) and automation to cut manual work: rules, imports, reconciliations, recurring entries

- Own and maintain accounting SOPs so the function scales as we add homes

- Research the right treatment when something new comes up, document it, and bring us the answer, not just the question



WHO YOU ARE

- Accountable. You hit deadlines without being chased. If something will slip, you say so early with a plan.

- A critical thinker. You ask "why does this number look like that?" before we do.

- An owner. You take initiative, propose projects, and finish them.

- A builder who loves to learn. You enjoy fast-paced, entrepreneurial environments where systems are still being built and you get to shape them.

- Comfortable with feedback. You clear review comments quickly and don't make the same mistake twice.



REQUIREMENTS

- CPA (Philippines) or BS Accountancy required; CPA strongly preferred

- 3+ years of accounting experience with US clients

- Hands-on trust accounting experience (property management, escrow, or client funds)

- Vacation rental / short-term rental or property management accounting experience

- US real estate accounting experience (rental properties, depreciation, capital improvements, multiple entities)

- Strong QuickBooks Online and Excel / Google Sheets skills

- Experience using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) in your accounting work, or a strong desire to

- Excellent written English

- Reliable internet, backup power, and at least 4 hours of overlap with US Eastern business hours



Nice to have: Hospitable, Guesty, OwnerRez or another vacation rental PMS; month-end close for multiple entities; owner statement experience; Asana.



WHAT WE OFFER

- Stable full-time role with a growing US company

- Flexible schedule (with set weekly deadlines and US-hours overlap)

- 2 weeks paid time off plus Philippine national holidays

- Raises and bonuses as the company grows and you take on more

- A real path to Controller as we scale



HOW TO APPLY

Apply with your resume and a short cover note that includes:

1. Your trust accounting experience: what type of trust account, how many owners/clients, and how you reconciled it.

2. Your vacation rental or property management experience: which companies and which software.

3. A short answer to this: A guest pays $1,500 for a stay. That includes a $350 cleaning fee the management company keeps (the cleaner costs $290). During the month, the manager also buys $80 of supplies for the owner on the company card. The management fee is 20% of nightly revenue. How would you record this, and what does the owner get paid?

4. One example of a process you improved or automated in a past role, and the result.



Start your subject line with "Trust Ledger" so we know you read the full listing. Applications without the answer to #3 won't be reviewed.
