title: SEO & Website Design Specialist (WordPress/Elementor) for a UK Marketing Studio
description:
Start your application with: Studio 5 SEO

(Applications that don't begin with this line won't be read.)



About us

Studio 5 is a small, friendly marketing studio in Norwich, UK (
). We look after social media, websites and marketing for small UK businesses: trades, clinics, jewellers, florists, engineering and technology companies, and interiors. Our clients are real people who care about how they look online, and so do we. Everything we produce is polished, warm and carefully checked before it goes live.



The role

We are looking for a reliable, detail-minded SEO and website design specialist to join us on a freelance, part-time basis. You will work directly with me on live client websites, improving how they look, how fast they load and how well they show up in Google, especially for local searches in the UK. If you enjoy turning search data into clear, practical improvements, and you take pride in clean, tidy design, this is for you.



What you'll be doing

- Working through lists of website amendments in Elementor (swapping images, changing buttons, fixing spacing, page layouts), checking every change on desktop and mobile, and telling me clearly what's done

- Building and editing pages on WordPress with Elementor, and on Squarespace

- On-page SEO using Rank Math or Yoast: titles, meta descriptions, headings, internal links, schema and image alt text

- Writing and improving website copy, service pages and blog posts in natural UK English, with a clear voice for each client

- Using Google Search Console and GA4 to find what's working, and what isn't

- Optimising Google Business Profiles and supporting local SEO (services, descriptions, posts, photos, reviews)

- Improving site speed: image compression, tidy media libraries, sensible file names

- Light design refreshes: layouts, buttons, call to action sections, trust sections and mobile checks

- Running a monthly SEO session for each client site, including a 28 day Search Console keyword gap review: you export the last 28 days of data, find keywords ranking in positions 10 to 30 that a page doesn't yet cover well, choose the best page for each, and suggest exactly where to add it (heading, paragraph or FAQ) with sample copy, avoiding clashes between pages and prioritising by impressions

- Keeping a short, clear record of what you changed, so clients and I can see the progress



You'll be a great fit if you have

- Proven experience with WordPress and Elementor (please include examples of sites you have built or improved)

- Hands-on experience with Rank Math or Yoast, Google Search Console and GA4

- A good eye for design, spacing and typography, and attention to detail

- Strong written English. UK spelling is a big plus

- Experience with local SEO and Google Business Profile

- Experience with Squarespace (nice to have)

- A reliable internet connection and the ability to work some UK hours

- Honesty and good communication. If something is unclear or you've made a mistake, you tell me early



Nice to have

- Experience with small local businesses in the UK

- Basic knowledge of schema, Core Web Vitals and page speed tools

- Canva skills for simple graphics



What we offer

- Steady, varied work on real client websites, with a clear monthly rhythm

- Clear briefs, quick feedback and respectful communication

- A friendly, supportive owner who values quality over speed

- Long-term work and room to grow for the right person



Paid trial task

Shortlisted applicants will be given a one-hour paid trial, paid at your agreed hourly rate. You'll tidy a single section of a staging page in Elementor, check it on mobile, and suggest one on-page SEO improvement for that page. You will be paid for the trial whether or not we work together afterwards. I'll send full details to shortlisted applicants only.



How to apply

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph only. Please do not apply anywhere else.

1. Start your application with: Studio 5 SEO

2. Share links to 2 or 3 websites you've built or improved, and what you did on each

3. Tell me which tools you use (WordPress/Elementor, Rank Math or Yoast, Search Console, GA4)

4. Tell me your hourly rate (we're offering US$10–$15), and which UK hours you can overlap on your working days



I look forward to meeting you.



Nicole

Studio 5, Norwich, UK

title: Scheduler / Staffing Coordinator
description:
Work Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 4:30 PM EST (that's 8:00 PM – 4:30 AM Philippine Time). This is a genuine night-shift commitment — please confirm you can sustain this schedule long-term before applying.



About You



You're confident and assertive on the phone. You can influence and persuade caregivers to take on open shifts — not just offer them and accept the first "no."



You're a creative problem-solver. When a shift won't fill the easy way, you think of options that make it work for everyone. For example, a caregiver hesitates at a client an hour away, so you point out that it's four days a week of steady, reliable hours, and they say yes.



You enjoy solving puzzles — a last-minute call-off is a challenge, not a crisis, and you stay level-headed while you fix it.



You have world-class written and spoken English. You'll be on the phone constantly with U.S. clients, families, and case managers — confident, clear, professional phone communication is non-negotiable, not a nice-to-have.



You have a sharp eye for detail and like things organized, accurate, and compliant — the kind of person who catches the error before it becomes a problem.



You're a natural completer who finishes what you start and doesn't let things slip.



You're a little competitive and like hitting targets — especially ones that contribute to team success.



You're willing and able to learn U.S. geography — specifically Delaware — well enough to make smart scheduling and routing decisions. We'll teach you; you bring the discipline to actually learn it.



About Us



We are a home care agency dedicated to compassionate, respectful, and professional service. We believe life is about living, not just existing — and that everyone deserves the dignity of care in the comfort of their own home. We deliver on that belief by providing the best care to clients in the communities we serve.



The Role



The Scheduling/Staffing Coordinator maximizes the efficiency and hours our caregivers deliver to our clients. You'll own the daily schedule: booking home visits for field staff, filling call-offs quickly, and keeping clients, caregivers, case managers, and office staff informed and coordinated. A big part of the job is actively persuading caregivers to pick up shifts — this role needs someone who leads the conversation, not someone who waits for answers. When schedules run smoothly, clients get consistent care and caregivers get reliable hours — you make that happen.



This is a high-caliber, well-compensated role. We're not looking for a generic VA — we're looking for someone who's genuinely excellent at this and will be paid accordingly.



Requirements



Minimum 5 years of scheduling/staffing coordination experience specifically within a home care agency (required) — this means coordinating field staff visiting clients in private homes, not assisted living facility scheduling and not generic staffing agency placement work

Hands-on experience with home care scheduling software (AlayaCare, WellSky, or similar) and managing multiple schedules simultaneously

Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook)

Excellent spoken and written English — near-native fluency required; phone screening will specifically assess verbal communication

Proven ability to be assertive and persuasive with field staff — comfortable pushing for a "yes" on hard-to-fill shifts while keeping the relationship positive

Willingness and ability to quickly learn U.S. geography, specifically the Delaware service area, as it's central to daily scheduling decisions

High attention to detail and the ability to multitask in a fast-paced, compliance-sensitive environment

Proactive, creative problem-solving mindset

Healthcare certification (RN, CNA, or similar) is a plus



Responsibilities



-Ensure accurate and appropriate scheduling for clients and staff.

-Persuade and motivate caregivers to accept open shifts, finding workable solutions when a shift is hard to fill.

-Manage calls from patients and field staff regarding scheduling issues.

-Enter and maintain accurate information in the Home Care operating software (AlayaCare).

-Communicate professionally with clients, family members, and staff.

-Document and maintain schedule notations timely to ensure compliance.

-Provide staffing coverage for call-offs and monitor clock-in/out accuracy of field staff.

-Answer incoming calls promptly and pleasantly.

-Relay information from referral sources, clients, family members, and case managers to appropriate personnel.

-Document and report client or staff concerns.

-Maintain accurate documentation in client and personnel files.

-Adhere to company-wide and specific performance standards.

-Collaborate with team members to identify opportunities to improve service delivery.

-Identify and proactively address scheduling challenges and process improvements.



How to Apply (Read Carefully)



We use structured systems and automation heavily, so attention to detail matters — starting with your application.



Step 1: Apply through OnlineJobs.ph



Step 2: In your application message, mention this EXACT role: Scheduler



Applications that do not follow these instructions exactly will not be considered.

title: Clinical Operations Manager – Registered Nurse
description:
Clinical Operations Manager – Registered Nurse



Home Health Experience Required



Full-Time Remote Position | Philippines-Based | U.S. Eastern Time Hours



Zeabe is a growing non-medical home care agency based in Delaware, USA. We provide dependable in-home care services and are building the clinical and operational systems needed to support continued growth while maintaining quality, compliance, and excellent client care.



We are looking for an experienced Registered Nurse with genuine Home Health/Home Care clinical operations experience to join us as our Clinical Operations Manager.



Please Read Before Applying



This is not a Virtual Assistant, Healthcare VA, Medical VA, Medical Receptionist, or general administrative position.



To be considered for this role, you must:



Be a licensed Registered Nurse.

Have worked professionally as an RN.

Have direct experience in a Home Health, Home Care, Private Duty, or comparable in-home care environment.

Have meaningful experience managing, coordinating, supervising, or overseeing clinical operations.

Have been responsible for ensuring other people complete required clinical work, documentation, visits, or deadlines.



If your experience is primarily administrative or Virtual Assistant work, even within healthcare, this position is unlikely to be the right fit.



Likewise, holding an RN license alone is not enough. We are specifically looking for someone who has used their nursing background within Home Health/Home Care and understands the operational side of delivering care in the home.



About the Role



The Clinical Operations Manager is responsible for the day-to-day operational execution of Zeabe's clinical services.



The role ensures clients move smoothly from referral through admission, ongoing supervision, recertification, required clinical visits, documentation, and ongoing service delivery while maintaining accurate records, timely follow-up, and regulatory compliance.



You will work closely with our Clinical Director and serve as the operational leader behind the clinical function.



While the Clinical Director owns overall clinical standards, quality, and clinical leadership, the Clinical Operations Manager owns much of the coordination, execution, monitoring, accountability, and follow-through required to make sure clinical work actually gets completed correctly and on time.



You will work across:



Clinical Support Team

Staffing Coordinator

PRN Registered Nurses

Client admissions

Recertifications

Supervisory visits

Clinical documentation

Clinical scheduling and assignments

Compliance-related follow-up

Operational tracking and reporting



This is primarily a Clinical Operations Management position, not a bedside nursing role.



However, your RN background is essential because you must understand the clinical work you are coordinating, recognize when something does not look right, communicate effectively with nurses, identify potential clinical risks, and understand what needs to be escalated.



Primary Objective



Build and operate a reliable clinical operating system that consistently delivers timely, compliant, accurate, and well-coordinated care.



What You Will Be Responsible For

Coordinate clinical operations from referral and admission through ongoing supervision and service delivery.

Ensure admissions, recertifications, supervisory visits, documentation, and follow-up activities are completed accurately and on time.

Maintain accurate, complete, and compliant clinical records across required systems.

Lead the Clinical Support Team and Staffing Coordinator to deliver consistent operational outcomes.

Coordinate PRN Registered Nurse assignments and monitor completion of required clinical activities.

Identify operational risks, resolve process gaps, and appropriately escalate clinical concerns.

Maintain clear visibility over outstanding clinical work so we know what needs to be completed, who owns it, when it is due, and what requires escalation.

The Experience We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who has actually worked inside Home Health or Home Care clinical operations.



Your experience may include areas such as:



Home Health or Home Care clinical operations

Managing or coordinating field nurses

Admissions or Start of Care processes

Recertifications

Supervisory or reassessment visits

Plans of Care

Clinical documentation review

Chart audits

Clinical compliance

Quality assurance

Tracking required clinical visits

Managing overdue documentation

Coordinating nurses and clinical support staff

Correcting incomplete clinical records

Following up on missed clinical requirements

Clinical scheduling

Home Health EMR/EHR systems

Medicaid, Medicare, VA, Private Duty, or other regulated home-based care environments



You do not need to have performed every item on this list.



What matters is that you have genuine clinical operations experience, rather than simply providing administrative support to people who managed clinical operations.



What This Role Really Requires



This position requires much more than maintaining a task list.



You will be expected to know:



What needs to be completed.

Who is responsible for completing it.

What is currently outstanding.

What is overdue.

What does not appear accurate.

What needs follow-up.

What needs escalation.

What recurring problems need a better system.



If a required nursing visit has not happened, we expect you to notice.



If documentation is incomplete, we expect you to identify it.



If someone tells you something is being handled but it remains unresolved, we expect you to follow it through.



If the same problem keeps occurring, we expect you to help determine why and improve the underlying process.



Leadership and Accountability



We are not looking for someone who simply waits to receive assignments.



The successful person will be comfortable:



Taking ownership of operational outcomes.

Directing and coordinating other team members.

Checking whether work has actually been completed.

Following up when deadlines are missed.

Addressing incomplete or inaccurate clinical documentation.

Asking questions when information does not appear correct.

Holding nurses and support team members accountable for agreed requirements.

Maintaining urgency around important clinical work.

Escalating concerns rather than allowing them to remain unresolved.

Following an issue through until it is fully closed.

Improving processes when the same problem repeatedly occurs.



You should be comfortable having a conversation such as:



"This was due yesterday and has not been completed. What is preventing completion, and when will it be finished?"



You can be professional and respectful while still being clear and firm about expectations.



This Role Is Likely a Good Fit for You If...

You are an RN who has genuinely worked in Home Health/Home Care.

You understand clinical operations beyond simply providing nursing care.

You have coordinated, supervised, or managed nurses or clinical support staff.

You naturally take ownership rather than waiting to be told what to do next.

You notice when a required visit, signature, document, date, or clinical item is missing.

You do not assume something has been completed just because someone says they are working on it.

You continue following up until an issue is completely resolved.

You are comfortable checking other people's work.

You address missed deadlines rather than avoiding uncomfortable conversations.

You work with a sense of urgency while maintaining accuracy.

You enjoy bringing structure and order to complicated clinical workflows.

You prefer clear standards, documented processes, and measurable outcomes.

You can quickly explain the current status of important outstanding items.

You question information when it appears incomplete or inconsistent.

You enjoy improving systems so the same operational problems do not continue happening.





This Role Is Probably Not for You If...

Your healthcare experience is primarily as a Virtual Assistant or Healthcare VA.

You have never worked professionally as a Registered Nurse.

You hold an RN license but have never used it professionally in Home Health/Home Care.

Your nursing background is exclusively bedside hospital nursing with no meaningful Home Health/Home Care operational experience.

You have supported a Clinical Manager but have never personally been accountable for clinical operational outcomes.

You prefer receiving clearly defined individual tasks rather than owning a process.

You avoid following up with people when deadlines are missed.

You are uncomfortable checking another nurse's documentation or work.

You tend to accept that something is being handled without verifying completion.

You regularly need your manager to tell you what to do next.

You dislike detailed documentation, compliance requirements, or structured processes.

You prioritize avoiding uncomfortable conversations over addressing an important missed requirement.

You tend to start many things but struggle to consistently close them.



Required Qualifications



You must have:



An active Registered Nurse license.

Professional experience working as an RN.

Direct Home Health, Home Care, Private Duty, or comparable in-home care experience.

Clinical operations experience.

Experience coordinating, supervising, or managing nurses and/or clinical support personnel.

Experience managing documentation, clinical visits, deadlines, follow-up, or compliance requirements.

Strong written and spoken English.

Excellent attention to detail and documentation accuracy.

Confidence following up on late, incomplete, or inaccurate work.

The ability to distinguish routine operational issues from matters requiring clinical escalation.

Experience using healthcare technology, EHR/EMR software, Home Health software, or comparable clinical systems.

Strong working knowledge of spreadsheets and cloud-based business applications.

The ability to work independently and take ownership.

Availability to work the required U.S. Eastern Time schedule.



Preferred Experience



The following experience would be particularly valuable:



U.S. Home Health experience

U.S. healthcare experience

Medicaid

VA Community Care

Medicare-certified Home Health

Private Duty/Home Care

Quality Assurance

Clinical compliance

Chart auditing

Managing remote or offshore clinical teams

AlayaCare or comparable Home Health software



These are preferred rather than mandatory unless otherwise stated above.



Systems and Technology



You may work with systems including:



AlayaCare

Microsoft Teams

SharePoint

Microsoft Excel

Microsoft Word



Front

Aircall

Trainual

Zoom

Claude



You are not expected to have prior experience with every system.



We are much more interested in whether you are comfortable learning technology, using structured systems consistently, and maintaining accurate information.



Working Hours



This is a full-time remote position working:



8:00 AM to 4:30 PM U.S. Eastern Time, Monday through Friday



Please consider the corresponding Philippine overnight working hours before applying.



Compensation



USD $1,800 to $2,400 per month



Compensation will depend on directly relevant experience, including:



Home Health/Home Care experience

Clinical Operations Management experience

RN experience

Leadership experience

U.S. or PH healthcare experience

Overall fit for the position





How to Apply (Read Carefully)



We use structured systems and automation heavily, so attention to detail matters — starting with your application.



Step 1: Apply through OnlineJobs.ph



Step 2: In your application message, mention this EXACT role: Clinical Operations



Applications that do not follow these instructions exactly will not be considered.

title: Performance Graphic Designer for Beauty & Skincare Ads
description:
We’re seeking a Performance Graphic Designer to produce high-converting static ads for a fast-growing DTC beauty brand.



This position centers on direct-response advertising — not general branding or organic social media design.



You should be able to interpret a creative brief, identify the right information hierarchy and visual format, and independently translate the strategy into a strong static ad built for paid social.



Compensation includes a competitive monthly base salary plus performance-based bonuses for creatives that achieve meaningful results.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



- Create performance-focused static ads for Meta and other paid social channels based on creative briefs.

- Translate hooks, copy, offers, proof points, and product benefits into clear, compelling visual hierarchy.

- Select and adapt suitable layouts, swipe references, and proven ad formats for different creative concepts.

- Produce meaningful iterations of winning ads by testing headlines, visuals, layouts, proof elements, CTAs, and other variables.

- Use AI tools to create or edit models, facial expressions, skin details, gestures, product scenes, backgrounds, and other required assets.

- Work closely with Creative Strategists, respond quickly to feedback, and deliver organized editable files in the required formats.



REQUIREMENTS



- Proven experience creating direct-response static ads for DTC or e-commerce brands.

- Strong understanding of typography, information hierarchy, readability, composition, and conversion-focused design.

- Able to understand and execute creative briefs independently — not just copy references mechanically.

- Experienced in producing multiple meaningful variations from one winning concept.

- Proficient in Figma and/or Photoshop, with strong practical experience using AI image-generation and editing tools.

- Strong attention to product accuracy, human anatomy, faces, hands, skin texture, lighting, and overall visual realism.

- Fast, reliable, detail-oriented, and comfortable with frequent creative testing and revisions.

- Beauty, skincare, cosmetics, wellness, or personal care experience is a strong plus.

- Ability to suggest controlled copy or wording variations is also a plus.



HOW TO APPLY



PLEASE FOLLOW ALL INSTRUCTIONS BELOW. APPLICATIONS THAT DO NOT FOLLOW THESE REQUIREMENTS MAY NOT BE CONSIDERED.



Please include the following:



1. Your portfolio link, preferably including direct-response static ads for paid social.

2. If you have worked with any beauty, skincare, cosmetics, wellness, or personal care brands, please specify the brand names and include links to relevant work.

3. Your CV or LinkedIn profile.

4. What is your current work situation? Are you employed full-time, working part-time, freelancing, or currently available?

5. When would you be available to start if selected?

6. What is your expected monthly salary in USD?

7. What design tools do you regularly use? Please specify your experience with Figma and/or Photoshop.

8. What AI image-generation or editing tools do you use? Briefly explain how you use them in your workflow.

9. From a clear creative brief with the necessary assets provided, how many NET-NEW STATIC AD CONCEPTS can you normally complete in one working day?

10. From an existing concept or winning ad, how many MEANINGFUL VARIATIONS can you normally complete in one working day?



Please do not count simple resizes or format adaptations as new creatives.



11. How long do you normally need to revise one static ad after receiving clear feedback?

12. Briefly explain how you would take one winning static ad and turn it into multiple genuinely different variations for further testing.

We're looking for a content creator who wants to build our agency's Instagram from the inside. You'll talk to camera about creative strategy, UGC, eCommerce marketing, eCommerce advertising and scaling brands, create UGC and AI ads, jump on trending ideas, film with our team, and run your own content calendar within TAS Digital, part-time.



As a Content Creator at TAS Digital, you are the face and voice of our Instagram, and you manage the ideas and content behind it. Your role is to turn what our strategists, editors and designers know into content people want to watch, save and share.



⚠️ BEFORE YOU APPLY

You must be a creator yourself: you film yourself with your phone, talk to the camera and explain things. This is the way you will work with us. Your portfolio must show videos of you talking to the camera.

This is an example of the content you will create:

🚀 ABOUT US

At TAS Digital, we're a fast-growing European performance creative agency working with global brands across the world. We're a fully remote team of experts who are passionate about growth, both for our clients and ourselves.



Our culture is built on continuous learning, collaboration, and excellence. We believe in strong client relationships, strong team relationships, and giving everyone the independence to do their best work while working hard together toward shared goals. If you're driven, eager to learn, and ready to make an impact on a global scale, you'll fit right in.

You are creating content for TAS Digital's own Instagram across five topics: creative strategy, UGC, eCommerce marketing, eCommerce advertising and scaling brands. On top of talking-to-camera content, you'll produce UGC and AI ads that show what we do. You'll own your content from idea to post: ideate (alone and with the team), script, film, and work with our editors to finish it.

title: Senior Advertising Manager
description:
Senior Advertising Manager



Adverio | Remote | Internal Leadership Role



About Adverio:



Adverio is an Amazon marketplace advisory and execution agency helping mid-seven to nine-figure brands grow. We work across advertising, SEO, CRO, content, and business intelligence. For more information, please visit: 



What This Role Is:



You own advertising as a function. Not one account. All of them.



Every Advertising Manager works from the standards you set. When advertising performance holds up across the portfolio, that is your win. When it slips across multiple accounts, that is your problem to diagnose and fix, at the level that stops it recurring rather than patching it account by account.



Your leverage is methodology and people. You build the SOPs, the quality bar, and the campaign approval discipline. You develop the Managers and hold them to that standard. You track what Amazon, Walmart, and Target change and get it to the team before it costs a client anything. You run the weekly Advertising L10 and report the function's health to the Brand Strategist.



You are not in accounts day to day. Account strategy belongs to the Brand Strategist and the Advertising Manager. But when an account goes materially into the red and guidance, training, or process fixes will not turn it around, you go in and help fix it. That is not a failure of the role. That is the role, used correctly, when the situation earns it.



The line that matters: you do not enter accounts because it feels productive. You enter when the system cannot solve it and someone with your depth is genuinely what the account needs.



What You Will Do:



- Own advertising results, quality, and methodology across every client account

- Monitor portfolio-wide performance and diagnose declines at the system level

- Build and maintain advertising SOPs, frameworks, quality standards, and campaign approval thresholds

- Hire, develop, coach, and hold every Advertising Manager accountable

- Step into an underperforming account directly when guidance and training will not correct it

- Track platform changes across Amazon, Walmart, and Target and cascade them before they cause client impact

- Catch cross-account patterns and fix them once, properly, at the SOP or training level

- Run the weekly Advertising L10 and report scorecard, Rock progress, and capacity to the Brand Strategist

- Lead quarterly planning for the advertising function



What This Role Is Not:



- Not a client-facing seat. You do not run client calls or own client relationships

- Not day-to-day account management. Managers own their accounts, you own the standard they work to

- Not a Specialist management role. That sits with the Advertising Manager

- Not a seat where the answer to a performance problem is to take the account over by default

- If you need to be the person in the platform every day, this is the wrong role. If you want a team of Managers who all operate at a level you set, it is the right one.



Experience We Require:



- 7+ years in marketplace advertising, with Amazon as your primary depth. Walmart and Target experience is a strong plus

- Proven experience leading advertising managers or specialists, not just running campaigns well yourself

- Demonstrated ownership of advertising performance across a portfolio of accounts, not a single brand

- Current knowledge. Your experience only counts if the last twelve months are part of it. You should be able to tell us what has meaningfully changed in Amazon advertising recently and what you did about it



How You Work:



- You measure yourself by how your team performs, not by being the sharpest practitioner in the room

- You have hard coaching conversations early, directly, and without softening them into nothing

- Your instinct when something breaks is to fix the system so it does not break again

- You track platform changes because you want to, not because someone assigned it

- You know the difference between a problem the system should solve and a problem that genuinely needs you in it



How Success Is Measured:



- Advertising performance holds or improves across the portfolio

- Brands hit their advertising goals, and advertising is a reason they stay with us

- Every Advertising Manager operates from the same current standard

- Managers are visibly better this quarter than last

- Platform changes reach the team before a client notices anything

- Brand Strategists never have to train or fix a Manager's capability gap themselves

- Weekly reporting to the Brand Strategist is accurate and on time, every week



Location:



Remote. We are open on location and hire globally.



How to Apply:



Please send us your application letter and most updated CV. Application subject should be: "Applicant - Senior Advertising Manager".

title: Accountability Coach - $300/month
description:
We run a program where people hire a "Boss" for their personal life.



Our members are building businesses, writing books, releasing music, getting fit. They already know what to do. They just don't do it, because nobody is expecting them to.



So we give them a Boss. You would be that Boss.



WHAT YOU'D ACTUALLY DO

You'd look after a few small teams, about 4 to 12 people in total.



Every week, each person tells you three times for each day: what time they'll wake up, what time they'll start work, and what time they'll submit proof of what they got done.



Your job is to notice when they don't. There will be a specific platform the check-ins will happen on (it looks like a regular chat for messages).



If someone doesn't check in at 7:00, you message them at 7:05. If they don't reply, you call them at 7:10. Friendly and direct, no lecture. Something like: "morning, missed you at check-in. what's going on today?"



The rest of the time you keep the team chats alive. Cheering people on, responding to their messages, seeing how they are doing, asking how the thing they were stuck on is going.



Once a week you run 20-minute 1:1 meetings with each member of your team as a quick weekly touch base on their goals, and helping them plan their next week's worth of check-ins.



THE SCHEDULE

Depending on how many members are assigned to you, your work will fluctuate. Check-ins are as quick as responding to a message, with more time spent texting/calling them if they haven't shown up. As these times range throughout the day, most of the day will be flexible. Check-ins will go from Monday through Saturday, with no check-ins Sunday apart from the 1:1 meetings.



Hours are flexible and accommodating as you may give away check-ins that don't work with your schedule to others. Pay based on overall experience, fit, English ability, coaching ability and number of members assigned. Full roster can range between $300/month to $400 with potential to increase to $500/month based on performance.



Between those check-in times, your time is your own. Most people do this alongside other work, and that is completely fine. We encourage it.



We are hiring for two shifts:

- US time zone

- European/Asian time zone



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- Reliable. This is the whole job. If you say you will message someone at 7:05, you message them at 7:05.

- Organized. You will be tracking 12 people's schedules without dropping anyone.

- Warm and easy to talk to. People should be glad you messaged them.

- Excellent English, written and spoken. You will be on video every week. Clear and easy to understand.

- Reliable 24/7 access to internet, with a backup, and a plan for brownouts.

- A good camera and microphone.

- Comfortable sending text messages and making short phone calls.



Experience in customer support, online English teaching, client success, or community management is a big plus. Coaching experience is a plus too.



HOW TO APPLY

Send an
 to 
 with a video of yourself explaining why you're interested in the job, how you spend the rest of your time (what other obligations do you have), and why you'd be a good fit. Please don't rehearse your answers or read them off the screen. Just talk to us naturally!

We don't want someone who simply sends outreach messages. We want someone who can build a creator machine.**



 4. Performance, Analytics & Reporting- You'll be accountable for the performance of the channel.

- Trybe creator activity and content output

 Who We're Looking For

title: Experienced B2B Cold Caller (Outbound/Inbound)
description:
Experienced B2B Cold Caller (Outbound/Inbound)



About Us



AI PSYOP is a US-based AI implementation, marketing, automation, and business consulting agency. We help service-based businesses increase profitability, improve sales performance, streamline operations, and scale through strategic marketing, artificial intelligence, and business automation.



We work with business owners across various industries, including HVAC, plumbing, roofing, electrical, automotive repair, cleaning services, and other service-based businesses throughout the United States.



About the Role



We are looking for an experienced B2B Cold Caller who can handle both outbound prospecting and inbound sales inquiries.



We are NOT looking for someone who simply reads scripts, makes calls, and books appointments. We need a sales professional who can think independently, actively listen, understand business challenges, ask relevant questions, and confidently communicate with business owners and decision-makers.



You must be capable of adapting to different conversations without relying entirely on a script.



Key Responsibilities



* Conduct outbound cold calls to US business owners and decision-makers.

* Handle inbound calls and respond promptly to incoming leads.

* Build rapport and establish credibility through natural, professional conversations.

* Conduct initial discovery using consultative selling techniques.

* Identify prospects’ challenges in marketing, sales, customer service, and business operations.

* Understand prospects’ current processes, software, and business systems.

* Identify operational inefficiencies, potential revenue loss, and opportunities for improvement.

* Handle objections confidently and professionally.

* Qualify prospects based on their business needs and suitability for our services.

* Schedule qualified discovery and technical consultation appointments.

* Follow up with prospects through phone calls, SMS, and
.

* Re-engage previous leads and nurture potential clients.

* Maintain accurate prospect information, call notes, and pipeline updates in our CRM.

* Participate in daily training, role-playing exercises, and call reviews.

* Submit daily performance reports.

* Coordinate with management, marketing, sales, and technical teams.

* Follow company outreach, consent, and do-not-call procedures.



Required Qualifications



* Minimum of 2 years of B2B cold-calling or outbound sales experience.

* Experience handling both inbound and outbound sales calls.

* Previous experience communicating with US business owners and decision-makers.

* Excellent spoken and written English.

* Strong English comprehension, clear pronunciation, and natural conversational delivery.

* Excellent active listening and critical-thinking skills.

* Strong discovery, lead qualification, and objection-handling skills.

* Ability to ask relevant follow-up questions without relying entirely on a script.

* Ability to understand and communicate complex products and services.

* Strong organizational and time-management skills.

* Comfortable receiving constructive feedback and participating in regular training.

* Reliable, accountable, proactive, and results-driven.

* Available to work full-time during US business hours.



Preferred Qualifications



* Experience in consultative B2B sales.

* Familiarity with SPIN Selling and GAP Selling methodologies.

* Experience selling high-ticket services, SaaS, digital marketing, or business consulting.

* Experience working with US service-based businesses.

* Familiarity with GoHighLevel, Apollo, or similar CRM and prospecting platforms.

* Basic understanding of AI, automation, digital marketing, and business operations.

* Experience identifying business pain points and their financial impact.



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)



Performance will be evaluated based on:



* Daily outbound call activity.

* Inbound lead response time.

* Quality of prospect conversations.

* Discovery and qualification effectiveness.

* Qualified appointments booked.

* Appointment attendance rates.

* Lead-to-appointment conversion rates.

* Follow-up consistency.

* CRM accuracy and documentation.

* Professionalism, attendance, and coachability.



We prioritize quality conversations and qualified business opportunities, not just the number of calls made or appointments booked.



Technical Requirements



* Reliable desktop or laptop computer.

* Stable high-speed internet connection.

* Professional noise-canceling headset.

* Quiet and distraction-free working environment.

* Backup internet connection.

* Contingency plan for power interruptions.



What We Offer



* Competitive base salary based on experience and qualifications.

* Performance-based incentives.

* Permanent work-from-home opportunity.

* Full-time, long-term career opportunity.

* Structured sales training and professional development.

* Access to professional CRM, prospecting, and AI-powered sales tools.

* Opportunities for career advancement based on performance.



How to Apply



Please submit the following through OnlineJobs.ph:



1. Updated resume.

2. A 2-minute video introduction highlighting your B2B sales experience.

3. A brief summary of your previous sales campaigns, industries, and responsibilities.

4. Previous performance metrics, including qualified appointments booked and conversion rates, if available.

5. A sample cold-call recording, if available and authorized for sharing.

6. Your availability to start.



Please also answer the following scenario in your own words:



You are speaking with an HVAC business owner who tells you:



“We already use ServiceTitan, and we already have AI and automation in our business. Why would we need your services?”



How would you respond, and what follow-up questions would you ask to better understand their business?



Please use “B2B SALES PROFESSIONAL” as your application subject.



Recruitment Process



Shortlisted applicants will undergo:



* Initial screening interview.

* English communication and comprehension assessment.

* Live, unscripted cold-call simulation.

* Discovery and objection-handling assessment.

* Final interview.

* Paid performance trial.



This is NOT an entry-level position. We are looking for an experienced sales professional who understands the difference between making phone calls and creating genuine business opportunities.



If you are confident in your sales abilities, enjoy meaningful conversations with business owners, and want to build a long-term career with a growing AI and business consulting agency, we would love to hear from you.

title: NDIS Business Operations & Growth Manager
description:

Salary: AUD $1,200–$1,800 per month, depending on experience

Start date: Immediate



About Us



Thrive Disability Activity Support (ThriveDAS) is a growing Australian disability support business specialising in personalised, activity-based support.



We are looking for a highly independent, proactive and commercially minded individual to take ownership of our daily business operations, improve our existing systems and drive profitable growth.



This is not a traditional virtual assistant position. We want someone who can identify problems, develop solutions and implement improvements without requiring constant direction.



Responsibilities



Operations and administration



* Take ownership of invoicing, administration and routine business processes.

* Prepare support worker payment summaries and reconcile outstanding invoices.

* Manage routine communications, scheduling and documentation within approved procedures.

* Coordinate support worker recruitment and onboarding.

* Develop and maintain standard operating procedures.



Systems and automation



* Review our existing spreadsheets, invoicing systems and workflows.

* Research, recommend and implement more efficient systems.

* Automate repetitive administrative tasks using AI and other technologies.

* Reduce operating costs and unnecessary manual work.

* Ensure systems are documented, secure and transferable.



Marketing and business development



* Manage our existing external marketing agency.

* Develop and implement lead generation strategies.

* Build referral relationships with relevant Australian organisations.

* Generate suitable participant enquiries and coordinate follow-ups.

* Identify opportunities to increase recurring revenue and profitability.



Business performance



* Prepare concise weekly financial and operational reports.

* Monitor revenue, expenses, profitability and growth.

* Identify opportunities to improve margins.

* Build a business that can operate independently of its owner.



Requirements



* Previous experience in business operations, administration or management.

* Experience with Australian NDIS or disability support businesses strongly preferred.

* Strong understanding of invoicing, spreadsheets and financial administration.

* Experience with marketing, lead generation or business development.

* Strong technology, AI and process automation skills.

* Excellent written and spoken English.

* Strong attention to detail and confidentiality.

* Ability to work independently, solve problems and take responsibility for outcomes.



What Success Looks Like



Within the first 30 days, we expect you to have:



* Taken ownership of routine administration and invoice preparation.

* Identified and started implementing improvements to existing systems.

* Established an active lead generation and referral strategy.

* Significantly reduced the owner’s daily administrative involvement.

* Established clear reporting and measurable growth targets.

Please submit your resume and answer the following questions:

2. Describe a business process you independently improved or automated. What were the results?

3. How would you approach taking over an inefficient invoicing and administration system?

4. How would you generate new clients for an Australian disability support business?

We are looking for a long-term team member who can grow with the business. Increased remuneration and responsibilities may be available based on demonstrated performance.

title: SEO & AEO Specialist
description:
SEO & AEO SPECIALIST – Financial Advisor Marketing Agency

Full-Time · Remote · Night Shift



Type of work: Full Time

Hours: 40 per week

Shift (PH time): 8 PM–5 AM, Mon–Fri



Key skills: SEO · Technical SEO · AEO · WordPress · Google Search Console · Google Analytics · Semrush · BrightLocal · Local SEO





ABOUT MIDSTREAM MARKETING



Midstream Marketing is a US-based digital marketing agency that helps independent financial advisors grow. We build websites and run SEO, content, advertising,
 and PR campaigns for advisory firms across the United States. We also support a small number of nonprofit and local service clients. We are a close-knit, family-oriented team, and we look out for each other. We respect the time you spend with your own family and keep your schedule predictable.





ABOUT THE ROLE



We are looking for an experienced SEO & AEO Specialist to lead search visibility for our client websites. Your goal is to help our clients get found on Google and cited by AI tools such as ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews and Perplexity, and to show the results in clear monthly reports.



You will report to our CEO and work closely with our Director of Operations, Operations Coordinator, Web Developer and QA Specialist. You will manage SEO and AEO for several client websites at a time. This is a long-term, full-time role for a proven expert who follows a defined process: you will work from our checklists, SOPs and ClickUp templates, and every completed task is reviewed. We also welcome the experience and strategy you bring: if you know a better way to get results, our leadership team wants to hear it and is open to changing how we work.





KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Technical SEO

• Audit client websites and run monthly crawls covering indexing, sitemaps, robots.txt, redirects, canonical tags and broken links.

• Improve Core Web Vitals and page speed, or write clear tickets for our Web Developer.

• Write, test and maintain JSON-LD schema markup.



Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)

• Measure how often each client is cited in AI-generated answers, and grow that share every month.

• Structure content so AI tools can find and quote it: direct answers, FAQ sections, clear entities and author bios.

• Stay current on changes in AI search and adjust our approach as they happen.



On-page SEO and content

• Research keywords, search intent and competitors, and turn the findings into monthly content plans.

• Optimize page titles, meta descriptions, headings, internal links and images.

• Write and edit SEO content briefs and web copy, and refresh pages that are losing rankings.

• Publish and update pages in WordPress.



Local SEO and authority building

• Optimize Google Business Profiles and keep business information consistent across the web.

• Earn quality backlinks through digital PR, partnerships and relevant directories, using white-hat methods only.



Reporting and collaboration

• Prepare a clear monthly SEO & AEO report for each client.

• Plan, track and update all work in ClickUp.

• Use AI tools to work efficiently, and verify all output before it is published.

• Follow compliance guidelines for financial services content.





AI AND CLAUDE



AI is part of our daily work. Our team uses Claude to research, draft, audit and report, and we are building it into the SEO and AEO process for every client. We are looking for someone who already works this way and wants to take it further.

• Use Claude and other AI tools every day for keyword research, content briefs, schema drafts, site audits and client reports.

• Help us build and improve the prompts, workflows and Claude skills we use for SEO and AEO work.

• Check every AI output for accuracy and compliance before it reaches a client or a live site.





SCOPE OF WORK



These are the standing deliverables for every client website you are assigned. Each one has a deadline and a clear standard for "done." Work outside this scope needs written approval before it starts.



• Onboarding audit (technical, on-page, local SEO and AEO)

   When: Within 10 business days of a new site being assigned

   Done means: A written audit with issues ranked by impact, plus a baseline for rankings, organic traffic and AI citations



• Monthly task plan

   When: First week of every month

   Done means: All tasks in ClickUp, each with a description, due date and expected result



• Technical health check

   When: Monthly

   Done means: Site crawled; critical issues fixed or ticketed within 5 business days



• On-page and content updates

   When: Weekly, following the monthly plan

   Done means: Changes live, checked on the live site and logged in ClickUp



• Schema markup

   When: Whenever pages are added or changed

   Done means: Passes Google's Rich Results Test and the 
 validator with no errors



• Google Business Profile updates

   When: Following the client's monthly plan

   Done means: Posts, photos and business details current and matching the website



• Backlinks and digital PR

   When: Following the client's monthly plan

   Done means: White-hat links only, each logged with its URL and date



• Rank and AI-citation tracking

   When: Monthly

   Done means: Rankings, Search Console data and AI-citation share compared with the baseline



• Client SEO & AEO report

   When: By the 28th of every month

   Done means: Results, work completed and next month's plan, written in plain English



• Weekly progress update

   When: Every week

   Done means: What is done, in progress, blocked or waiting for approval



• Daily status note

   When: Before the end of every shift

   Done means: A status note on every open ClickUp task



Work standards

• Track all work in ClickUp so the team can see what is done and what is next.

• Follow our SOPs and checklists for every task type. If a step does not fit, ask in the ClickUp task before changing it.

• Before starting non-routine work, post a short recap of your understanding in the ClickUp task and wait for confirmation.

• Get approval before publishing new pages, and before changing the URL, title or main heading of any page that already ranks.

• Get client or compliance sign-off on financial advisor content before it goes live. Content must never promise returns or results.

• Test every change on the live site before marking a task complete. Our QA Specialist reviews completed tasks.

• Record what you changed and when, so any change can be reviewed or reversed.

• Report a sudden drop in traffic or rankings, a site outage or de-indexed pages to the Operations team the same day.

• Use white-hat methods only, and fact-check and edit all AI-assisted content before it is published.

• Use only company-provided logins, and never share passwords.



Outside this role

Paid advertising (Google Ads and Meta Ads), social media management, graphic design and website development beyond SEO fixes are handled by other team members.





QUALIFICATIONS



Required

• At least 3 years of hands-on SEO experience, including managing several client websites at the same time.

• Proven results, with Search Console or GA4 screenshots you can share.

• Strong technical SEO skills, including writing JSON-LD schema by hand.

• Hands-on AEO experience: you have helped a website get cited in AI answers such as Google AI Overviews or ChatGPT.

• Confident working in WordPress.

• Proficient with Google Search Console, GA4, and Semrush or Ahrefs.

• Local SEO and Google Business Profile experience with US businesses, using tools such as BrightLocal.

• Excellent written English.

• A track record of following written processes, checklists and deadlines, and of asking before changing an agreed approach.

• Regular use of AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT.



Preferred

• SEO experience in financial services or other regulated industries, such as legal or healthcare.

• Familiarity with ClickUp, Claude, DataForSEO, Looker Studio or Agency Dashboard.

• Basic HTML and CSS.

• A bachelor's degree in marketing, IT, communications or a related field.



Please note: we do not use PBNs, link farms or paid links. If these are part of your approach, this role is not the right fit.





REMOTE WORK REQUIREMENTS



We are a fully remote team working across time zones, so you need a reliable home-office setup from your first day.

• Computer: a laptop or desktop with at least an Intel Core i5, AMD Ryzen 5 or Apple M1 processor and 8 GB of RAM (16 GB preferred), running Windows 10 or 11 or a current version of macOS. A second monitor is preferred.

• Internet: a stable fiber or cable connection of at least 25 Mbps download and 10 Mbps upload.

• Backup internet: a second connection, such as mobile data or a pocket Wi-Fi, of at least 10 Mbps.

• Backup power: a UPS, power station or generator that keeps your computer and internet running for at least 2 hours during a power outage.

• Headset and webcam: a noise-cancelling headset with a microphone, and an HD webcam. Cameras are on for team meetings.

• Workspace: a quiet, private space where you can take calls without background noise or interruptions.

• Tools: willing to install and use our time tracker (TMetric), ClickUp, Zoho Cliq and Zoom.

• Availability: online and reachable on team chat for your whole shift, replying to messages within 15 minutes.

• Attendance: request leave in advance, and message your supervisor before your shift starts if an emergency keeps you from working.

• Security: a computer used only by you, with current antivirus and system updates. No work on public Wi-Fi. You will sign a confidentiality agreement (NDA).





SCHEDULE AND COMPENSATION



• Full-time, 40 hours per week, fully remote.

• Fixed night shift: 8:00 PM – 5:00 AM Philippine time, Monday to Friday, with a 1-hour break. This covers most of the US team's working day; your start time is confirmed when you are hired.

• Performance review after 90 days, based on the scope of work above.





HOW TO APPLY



Please send:

1. Your resume.

2. Two SEO or AEO results you are proud of, with Search Console or GA4 screenshots and a short explanation of what you did.

3. Your expected monthly rate for 40 hours per week.

4. Your earliest available start date.

5. A screenshot of a recent internet speed test, for example from speedtest.net.

6. Your computer specifications, and your backup internet and backup power setup.

7. Links to your LinkedIn and social media profiles (for example
, Instagram or X).



Applications missing any of the seven items above, or the keyword below, will not be considered. Shortlisted applicants will complete a skills assessment that tests both their SEO and AEO skills and how closely they follow written instructions.



To show that you have read the full post, please begin your application with the words "PAGE ONE".

title: Youtube (Vlogs) Video Editor
description:
[THIS IS NOT A REELS EDITOR ROLE]

[THIS IS A 16:9 LONG-FORM FORMAT VIDEO EDITING ROLE]



We’re looking for a Video Editor with experience creating engaging YouTube and vlog-style content.



This role is best suited for someone who knows how to turn raw footage into a clear and enjoyable story, especially for travel, lifestyle, personality-led, and long-form YouTube content. Experience focused only on short-form reels, ads, corporate videos, or highly effects-driven editing may not be the best fit for this role.

---





WHAT YOU’LL DO



- Review raw footage and choose the best moments for each video

- Turn footage into clear, engaging YouTube vlog stories

- Create strong intros, smooth pacing, and endings that keep viewers interested

- Cut filler, repetition, and unnecessary footage

- Add subtitles, on-screen text, music, and sound effects

- Improve audio quality and keep voices clear and consistent

- Apply color correction and grading

- Use B-roll, transitions, zooms, graphics, and effects where appropriate

- Organize footage and project files properly

- Handle revisions and feedback efficiently

- Prepare polished 16:9 videos ready for YouTube





WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR



- Experience editing YouTube videos, vlogs, travel, lifestyle, or personality-led content

- Strong sense of storytelling and pacing

- Able to identify which moments are worth keeping and which should be cut

- Good attention to audio, subtitles, timing, and visual consistency

- Comfortable editing phone-recorded and mixed-quality footage

- Comfortable working with CapCut, Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, and other relevant editing tools

- Experience with motion graphics or more advanced editing is a plus

- Open to feedback and able to deliver polished work with minimal revisions

- Reliable, organized, and detail-oriented

- Able to handle private footage professionally and confidentially





WORK SETUP



- Full-time contractual role

- 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Philippine Time

- Time tracker required

- No moonlighting or outside full-time employment





HOW TO APPLY



To confirm that you’ve read the full job post, please type "HELLO YOUTUBE" as the very first sentence of your application.



After that, please provide:



1. Your CV/Resume link. (yes, we also need your CV, not just your portfolio)

2. Your portfolio link showing your best 16:9 edited videos or vlog editing work.

3. A short TEXT introduction about your relevant video editing experience. Please keep it focused on experience related to this role.

4. Your expected monthly salary in USD, not hourly

title: Procurement & Planning Coordinator
description:
The Company



Nutriseed is on a mission to make healthy living easy. Our philosophy is simple: every mouthful of food should be both nourishing and delicious. We have spent years creating and curating the highest-quality health foods, ensuring they are free from hidden sugars, additives, and unnecessary processing while remaining affordable and accessible.



As a privately owned, self-funded, and profitable direct-to-consumer brand, Nutriseed has achieved double-digit year-on-year growth, and we’re scaling fast. With ambitious plans to double our revenue and likely our team size within the next three years, we are looking for a Supplier Planning and Procurement Coordinator to bring structure, clarity, and control to our stock and supply.



This is a critical role in making sure stock is planned and bought correctly, supplier commitments are delivered, and decisions are supported by accurate, timely data. The ideal candidate will embody and champion our core values:



🔹 We Always Deliver – Taking ownership and ensuring high standards in everything we do.

🔹 We Have a Growth Mindset – Continuously learning, adapting, and improving.

🔹 We Are Accountable – Taking responsibility for actions and outcomes.

🔹 We Care – Genuinely caring about our team, customers, and mission.



Do you have the planning skills, supplier experience, and attention to detail to keep a fast-growing brand in stock?

If so, read on: this could be the opportunity for you.



The Opportunity



Nutriseed is seeking a Supplier Planning and Procurement Coordinator to own demand planning, purchasing and supplier coordination, and the accuracy of the data and systems behind them, with bounded, structured support to the Founder.

This role is critical in ensuring stock is planned and bought correctly, supplier commitments are delivered, and decisions are supported by accurate, timely data.



What We Need From Our Supplier Planning and Procurement Coordinator:



Demand & Supply Planning (Primary Responsibility)

Own the forecasting and planning of stock to ensure smooth operations and minimise risk.



Key responsibilities:



Build and maintain weekly/ monthly/ quarterly and annual demand forecasts (SKU level)

Translate forecasts into production requirements

Turn forecasts and stock cover into purchase quantities and order dates, allowing for minimum order quantities and manufacturing and freight lead times

Monitor stock levels, coverage, and risks (OOS / overstock)

Work closely with Operations to align production planning

Flag risks early and propose solutions



Success looks like:



No unexpected stockouts

Reduced waste / overproduction

Clear forward visibility of stock requirements

Procurement & Supplier Coordination (Primary Responsibility)

Own purchasing and day-to-day supplier coordination, so the right stock is ordered on the right terms and arrives when needed.



Key responsibilities:



Lead supplier coordination and negotiation, including with manufacturers in China: pricing, payment terms and delivery commitments, within agreed approval limits



Raise and manage approved purchase orders, and track them through production, quality checks, freight/import and receipt, working with the teams responsible for each stage



Keep purchasing records in Unleashed accurate, including order status, receipts and reconciliation with the warehouse



Give Finance visibility of deposits, balances and due dates when orders are committed and whenever plans change



Success looks like:



Purchase orders placed on time and in the right quantities

Suppliers deliver against agreed commitments, with issues flagged early

Accurate, up-to-date purchasing records

Finance has early, accurate visibility of supplier payments

Systems & Process Improvement

Ensure systems are working efficiently and processes are clearly defined.

Key responsibilities:

Support and maintain integrations (Shopify, Unleashed, etc.)

Identify inefficiencies in current workflows

Document and improve processes

Work with team members to implement better systems

Success looks like:

Fewer operational errors

Clear, documented processes

Improved efficiency across teams

Key KPIs

Forecast accuracy

Stock availability (minimising stockouts)

Supplier delivery performance against agreed commitments

Accuracy of purchasing records and commitments, including Finance visibility

Reporting accuracy and timeliness

Reduction in system/data errors

Process improvements implemented



Your Role and Its Boundaries

To ensure focus and sustainability, the following are not part of this role:

Fulfilment or dispatch ownership

Factory or production leadership, or sign-off of food quality

Budget, P&L or spending authority

Marketing ownership

Wider cross-functional project management; routine supplier, purchasing and stock coordination stays with this role

General executive-assistant duties for the Founder

Ad hoc/reactive tasks from multiple team members

Constant task-switching or firefighting

Undefined “catch-all” responsibilities

All work should align with the core responsibilities above.

Ways of Working

Clear weekly structure and prioritisation

Tasks owned end-to-end with minimal interruption

Requests prioritised and batched where possible

Regular check-ins to ensure clarity and alignment



Who is the Right Fit for This Role?



Experienced in International Purchasing – You have proven hands-on experience owning international purchasing, including working with manufacturers in China: orders, pricing, payment terms, lead times and delivery.

A Demand & Stock Planner – You have experience in demand and stock planning.

Detail-Oriented – You have strong attention to detail.

Analytical & Structured – You bring analytical and structured thinking.

Comfortable with Data & Systems – You’re comfortable working with data and systems.

Organised & Process-Driven – You’re highly organised and process-driven.

Great at Prioritising – You can prioritise and manage your workload effectively.

A Clear Communicator – Your communication is clear and proactive.



What’s in it for You?



✅ Own a clearly defined role with a structured weekly rhythm, in a fast-growing, values-driven company.

✅ Be part of a mission-driven brand that is transforming the health food industry.

✅ Competitive salary & benefits, with opportunities for growth and development.

✅ Grow your career into Operations Management, Planning & Supply Chain Leadership, or Systems / Data Ownership across the business.

title: Customer Success Manager (Shopify / SaaS)

Job Description:

We are looking for a motivated, detail-oriented Customer Success Manager to join our growing SaaS team. You will take charge of onboarding new customers, support a portfolio of ambitious Shopify brands, and help them achieve measurable results using our optimization and personalization platform.   This role is ideal for someone with customer success experience, exposure to Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), and a background in Shopify who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment. You will work directly with innovative e-commerce brands as part of a lean team where ownership, initiative, and results are valued.   



Key Responsibilities

Customer Onboarding: Lead new customers through kickoff, platform setup, and initial launch to ensure they see value quickly.   



Account Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with a portfolio of 40+ Shopify brands from onboarding through renewal.   



Success Planning: Understand each customer's goals and translate them into clear, measurable success plans.   



Performance & Data Analysis: Monitor platform adoption, conduct light data analysis to spot opportunities or churn risks, and share regular performance updates.   



Campaign Support: Occasionally assist in setting up and launching A/B tests and personalization experiences to drive platform adoption.   



Issue Resolution & Feedback: Answer customer inquiries promptly, escalate technical issues to our product team, and share user feedback to help improve our software.   



Growth: Identify and flag upsell opportunities early.   





Requirements

Communication: Fluent, confident, and clear written and verbal English communication skills (MUST).   



Experience: At least 2 years of proven experience as a Customer Success Manager, Account Manager, or Retention Manager in SaaS, e-commerce, CMS, or web-based tech companies (MUST).   



E-commerce Background: Experience working with Shopify or similar e-commerce platforms (ADVANTAGE).   



Technical & Analytics Knowledge: Familiarity with CRO, A/B testing, UX, front-end basics, or Google Analytics (BIG ADVANTAGE).   



Analytical & Organizational Skills: Ability to interpret campaign results, explain findings clearly, and manage 40+ accounts simultaneously.   



Setup & Schedule: Reliable high-speed internet (100+ Mbps), a quiet workspace, and flexibility to work morning, mid, or night shifts (Philippine Time) to support global operations (Required).





What We Offer

Competitive, above-market base salary   



100% remote, long-term full-time role     



Clear opportunities for career growth as the company scales   



Access to modern AI-powered workflows and tools   





How to Apply

Please reply to this job post with:



A brief summary of your experience in Customer Success and/or Shopify/CRO.



A link to your updated resume.



Use the subject title: CRO

title: Influencer / UGC Outreach VA for Clothing Brand - find creators, send DMs, track replies (simple, long term)
description:
Hi! We run a streetwear and hikewear clothing brand - jackets and tracksuits

mainly. We're looking for one person to handle our influencer and UGC creator

outreach.



This is a simple, repetitive role and we want to be upfront about that. It is

not strategy and it is not content creation. It is finding the right creators,

messaging them, keeping track of everyone, and following up. If you like

organised, steady work you will do well here.



THE WORK

- Find creators that fit the brand. Mostly Instagram and TikTok, small to mid

  size accounts, in Australia, UK and US.

- Send the outreach message. We give you the message and the offer, you adapt

  it so it doesn't read like a copy paste.

- Keep a tracker. Who you contacted, when, on what platform, what they said,

  what the next step is, what date to follow up.

- Follow up. Most of this job's results come from the second and third message,

  not the first.

- Chase deliverables. People agree to post and then go quiet. You remind them,

  politely, until it's done.

- Short weekly summary. How many contacted, how many replied, how many booked,

  who's gone quiet.



WHAT WE'RE NOT ASKING YOU TO DO

- Negotiate rates or agree anything with a creator. You check with us first,

  every time.

- Make content, edit video or design anything.

- Run ads or post on our accounts.



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU (please read this part properly)

title: Ads Manager | Meta & Social Media| Full-Time, Remote
description:

What you'll do:

-Plan, launch, and manage paid campaigns on Meta 
/Instagram) and TikTok Ads 

-Own the full ad budget: daily pacing, scaling winners, killing losers, reallocating spend between channels based on performance 

-Brief the design team on ad creatives: write the hooks, scripts, and copy angles, specify formats, and give clear, data-backed feedback on what to make next and why

-Run a structured testing program covering creatives, audiences, and offers, one variable at a time, with documented learnings 

-Set up and maintain tracking: Meta pixel, TikTok pixel, GA4, UTMs 

-Send a daily performance report per platform (spend, CPC, CTR, cost per result, ROAS, action taken). We'll give you the template 

-Identify winning organic and creator content worth amplifying as paid 

-Recommend monthly budget allocation backed by data 

-Help us expand into Google Ads as we grow 



You must have 

-2 to 4+ years hands-on running Meta Ads with real budgets you controlled yourself  

-TikTok Ads experience, or strong fundamentals with a credible plan to ramp fast 

-Understand strong ads and be able to come up with iterations / create design briefs for the design team 

-Experience in how to set up ads effectively across a monthly budget 

-Proven ability to create designs that convert 

-Comfort with numbers: you know your past campaigns' CPA and ROAS without looking them up 

-Excellent written English for ad copy, briefs, and daily reports 

-Backup power and backup internet, verified on camera during onboarding. This is a hard requirement, not a preference 

-This will be your only job. No other clients, no freelance work on the side 



Nice to have 

-Google Ads experience in Search, Shopping/PMax, or YouTube. We plan to expand there, so this strengthens your application 

-Advantage+ shopping campaigns and broad-targeting creative strategy 

-Basic CapCut or Canva skills for quick ad variations without waiting on design 

-Spark Ads / creator whitelisting 

-AI tools for copy and research, and knowing where they fall short 



What we offer 

-Pay at the top of the market, in USD, on time, every time 

-A real multi-channel budget and full ownership of the results 

-A design team that makes your creative ideas real, so you can focus on strategy and performance 

-Direct access to the founder with no approval layers 

-Paid PH holidays and annual leave 

-Long-term role with raises tied to performance, not tenure 



Application 

-Include a link to your portfolio or a case study document showing campaigns you've run. We will review it together in the interview

title: Creator Partnerships Manager – Hydration Team
description:
ABOUT LAPS

Laps is a new premium sports drink from Amsterdam: real coconut water with added sodium and magnesium, made for people who train hard. We launch in January 2027 in the Netherlands, Germany and the UK, on our own webshop, Amazon, TikTok Shop and in retail. We're going up against the sports drink industry, and we're not doing it quietly.



We don't run ads. We grow through people. Your job is to build and lead our Hydration Team: 100 creators who get Laps every month and share it with their audience. These are long-term relationships, not one-off gifting.



KEY DETAILS

- Part-time, long-term, remote

- 20 hours per week, flexible, with at least 3 hours overlap with Amsterdam mornings (about 4–7 PM Philippine time)

- Pay: $500–800 per month, depending on experience

- Start: January 15 or February 1, 2027

- Paid 30-day trial, with a review at the end



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Build the Hydration Team

- Find the right creators on TikTok and Instagram: runners, cyclists, triathletes, Hyrox and gym athletes. Mostly micro-creators (2k–50k followers) in NL, DE and the UK

- Write personal outreach in English for UK creators. For NL and DE creators, send our Dutch and German templates, personalised with the details we give you. Ongoing contact after the first message is in English

- Onboard new ambassadors and make them feel welcome from day one



Look after the team

- Be the main contact for every ambassador: check in regularly, reply fast, and know what's going on in their training (races, PRs, injuries, events)

- Celebrate their wins: comment on and share their content, send a note when they finish a race

- Keep ambassadors involved with brand news, new drops and team moments

- Collect product feedback and ideas from the team

- Make sure creators follow our brief and claim rules (we'll give you the list of what can and can't be said)



TikTok Shop Affiliate Center

- Run our affiliate programme in TikTok Shop: commission plans, creator collaborations, invites and sample requests

- Track sales per creator and per video



TikTok brand account

- Build the Laps TikTok account from scratch together with the founder

- Post and schedule content (we produce the videos; you post, caption and time them)

- Engage daily: reply to comments, duet and stitch creator content



Test, measure, improve

- Review every ambassador after 2–3 months: keep the top performers, replace the weak ones, keep the team at 100

- Flag who could become a paid partner

- Ambassador rewards are tied to results (new subscribers via their code), so tracking must be accurate



Run the system

- Prepare the monthly shipping list of creator samples (our operations colleague handles the shipping)

- Track who posted, collect content links and ask permission to reuse content

- Keep our creator database up to date (UpPromote / Google Sheets), with notes on every ambassador



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- At least 1 year in influencer relations, creator partnerships or community management for a consumer brand

- Hands-on experience with the TikTok Shop Affiliate Center (creator collaborations, commission plans, samples), ideally in the UK or EU

- Experience growing a brand's TikTok account

- Excellent written English with a warm, casual tone

- You enjoy building relationships and remembering details about people

- You can spot fake followers and low engagement quickly

- Comfortable working with Dutch and German templates

- Organised and reliable: you follow up without being reminded

- You follow platform rules strictly. Never offer free product or payment in exchange for Amazon reviews

- Bonus: experience with sports, fitness, food or beverage brands

- Bonus: you know influencer disclosure rules (#ad / #gifted)



KPIs AND REPORTING

- Sales (GMV) per creator and per video

- Ambassador performance: posts, content quality, engagement and sales via discount codes, affiliate links and TikTok Shop

- Team size held at 100 active creators

- TikTok account growth and engagement

- Weekly report: new and active ambassadors, posts live, sales, highlights and issues

- Monthly overview: top performers, creators to replace, TikTok account results



HOW TO APPLY

Use the subject line "Hydration Team" and include:

1. A short intro about yourself

2. Brands you've worked with and the results you got

3. Your 30-day plan and how you would run the 3-month creator review

4. Test task: find 3 creators in the Netherlands who fit Laps, explain in one line each why, and write the first DM you'd send to one of them

5. Your availability and hourly rate



Applications missing points 2, 3 or 4 will not be reviewed.

title: E-commerce & TikTok Shop Operations Specialist
description:
